 148 | function buildContentSecurityPolicy() {
 149 |   const origin = getServerOrigin();
 150 |   const scriptSources = getCspSources('script_src', 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com https://cdn.jsdelivr.net');
 151 |   const styleSources = getCspSources('style_src', 'https://fonts.googleapis.com https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com https://cdn.jsdelivr.net');
 152 |   const fontSources = getCspSources('font_src', 'https://fonts.gstatic.com https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com');
 153 |   const connectSources = getCspSources('connect_src', 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com https://cdn.jsdelivr.net');
 154 |   // FIX (Issue #1): Removed 'unsafe-eval' from script-src — it allows arbitrary code execution.
 155 |   // Added 'wasm-unsafe-eval' for WebAssembly support without opening eval() hole.
 156 |   // Nonce-based inline script allowlist for Electron preload bridge.
 157 |   const CSP_NONCE = CSP_SCRIPT_NONCE;
 158 |   return [
 159 |     `default-src 'self' ${origin}`,
 160 |     `script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval' 'nonce-${CSP_NONCE}' ${origin} ${scriptSources}`,
 161 |     `style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' ${origin} ${styleSources}`,
 162 |     `font-src 'self' ${origin} ${fontSources}`,
 163 |     `img-src 'self' data: ${origin} https:`,
 164 |     `media-src 'self' ${origin} https:`,
 165 |     `connect-src 'self' ${origin} ${connectSources}`
 166 |   ].join('; ');
 167 | }

 177 | let currentResolve = null;

 187 |   if (app.isPackaged) {

 189 |   } else {

 194 | function startEngine() {
 195 |     return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
 196 |         const enginePath = getEnginePath();
 197 |         console.log(`[Nexus] Запуск движка: ${enginePath}`);
 198 |         
 199 |         if (!fs.existsSync(enginePath)) {
 200 |             const errorMsg = `Движок не найден: ${enginePath}. Скомпилируйте его в папке engine/`;
 201 |             console.error(`[Nexus Error] ${errorMsg}`);
 202 |             resolve({ status: 'error', message: errorMsg });
 203 |             return;
 204 |         }
 205 | 
 206 |         engineProcess = spawn(enginePath, [], {
 207 |             stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
 208 |             cwd: path.join(__dirname),
 209 |             windowsHide: true
 210 |         });
 211 | 
 212 |         engineProcess.stdout.setEncoding('utf8');
 213 |         let stdoutBuffer = '';
 214 | 
 215 |         engineProcess.stdout.on('data', (data) => {
 216 |             stdoutBuffer += data;
 217 |             
 218 |             // Обрабатываем полные JSON сообщения (разделенные \n)
 219 |             const lines = stdoutBuffer.split('\n');
 220 |             stdoutBuffer = lines.pop() || ''; // Оставляем неполную строку в буфере
 221 | 
 222 |             for (const line of lines) {
 223 |                 if (!line.trim()) continue;
 224 | 
 225 |                 // Detect engine ready signal during startup
 226 |                 if (!engineReady && engineStartResolve && line.toLowerCase().includes('ready')) {
 227 |                     engineReady = true;
 228 |                     const startResolve = engineStartResolve;
 229 |                     engineStartResolve = null;
 230 |                     startResolve({ status: 'ok', message: 'Engine started' });
 231 |                 }
 232 | 
 233 |                 try {
 234 |                     const response = JSON.parse(line);
 235 |                     
 236 |                     // Если это сообщение о прогрессе, пробрасываем в рендерер и НЕ резолвим промис
 237 |                     if (response.status === 'progress') {
 238 |                         const wins = BrowserWindow.getAllWindows();
 239 |                         if (wins.length > 0) {
 240 |                             wins[0].webContents.send('nexus-progress-update', response.message);
 241 |                         }
 242 |                         continue;
 243 |                     }
 244 | 
 245 |                     if (response.status === 'hook_request') {
 246 |                         const wins = BrowserWindow.getAllWindows();
 247 |                         if (wins.length > 0) {
 248 |                             wins[0].webContents.send('nexus-hook-request', response.hook, response.world);
 249 |                         }
 250 |                         continue; // Не резолвим основной промис, ждем hook_response
 251 |                     }
 252 | 
 253 |                     // Lightweight mod hook event — fire-and-forget, no world sync
 254 |                     if (response.status === 'hook_event') {
 255 |                         const wins = BrowserWindow.getAllWindows();
 256 |                         if (wins.length > 0) {
 257 |                             wins[0].webContents.send('nexus-hook-event', response.hook, response.data || {});
 258 |                         }
 259 |                         continue; // Не резолвим промис — это событие, не ответ на команду
 260 |                     }
 261 | 
 262 |                     // Realtime update from engine — stream world state to renderer immediately
 263 |                     if (response.status === 'realtime_update') {
 264 |                         const wins = BrowserWindow.getAllWindows();
 265 |                         if (wins.length > 0) {
 266 |                             wins[0].webContents.send('nexus-realtime-update', response);
 267 |                         }
 268 |                         continue; // Не резолвим промис — это стрим, не ответ на команду
 269 |                     }
 270 | 
 271 |                     if (currentResolve) {
 272 |                         const resolve = currentResolve;
 273 |                         currentResolve = null;
 274 |                         resolve(response);
 275 |                         processQueue();
 276 |                     }
 277 |                 } catch (e) {
 278 |                     console.error('[Nexus Parse Error]', e.message, line.substring(0, 500) + '... [TRUNCATED]');
 279 |                 }
 280 |             }
 281 |         });
 282 | 
 283 |         engineProcess.stderr.on('data', (data) => {
 284 |             console.error('[Nexus Stderr]', data.toString());
 285 |         });
 286 | 
 287 |         engineProcess.on('close', (code) => {
 288 |             console.log(`[Nexus] Движок завершен с кодом ${code}`);
 289 |             if (code !== 0 && code !== null) {
 290 |                 console.error(`[Nexus CRITICAL] Процесс упал. Если это произошло на ПК без среды разработки, убедитесь, что бинарник собран с флагом -static.`);
 291 |             }
 292 |             engineProcess = null;
 293 |             engineReady = false;
 294 |             
 295 |             // Отклоняем текущую команду если она была
 296 |             if (currentResolve) {
 297 |                 currentResolve({ status: 'error', message: `Engine connection lost (code ${code})` });
 298 |                 currentResolve = null;
 299 |             }
 300 |             // Очищаем очередь, чтобы не блокировать UI
 301 |             while (commandQueue.length > 0) {
 302 |                 const task = commandQueue.shift();
 303 |                 task.resolve({ status: 'error', message: `Engine crashed before execution (code ${code})` });
 304 |             }
 305 |         });
 306 | 
 307 |         engineProcess.on('error', (err) => {
 308 |             console.error('[Nexus Error]', err);
 309 |             reject(err);
 310 |         });
 311 | 
 312 |         // Wait for engine to signal readiness, with 10-second fallback timeout
 313 |         let startResolved = false;
 314 |         engineStartResolve = (result) => {
 315 |             if (startResolved) return;
 316 |             startResolved = true;
 317 |             engineStartResolve = null;
 318 |             resolve(result);
 319 |         };
 320 | 
 321 |         setTimeout(() => {
 322 |             if (!startResolved) {
 323 |                 startResolved = true;
 324 |                 engineStartResolve = null;
 325 |                 engineReady = true;
 326 |                 resolve({ status: 'ok', message: 'Engine started (ready signal timeout)' });
 327 |             }
 328 |         }, ENGINE_START_TIMEOUT_MS); }); } function sendCommand(command, params = {}, timeoutMs = DEFAULT_ENGINE_TIMEOUT_MS) {
 329 |     return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
 330 |         if (!engineProcess || !engineReady) {
 331 |             resolve({ status: 'error', message: 'Engine not ready' });
 332 |             return;
 333 |         }
 334 | 
 335 |         const message = JSON.stringify({ command, ...params }) + '\n';
 336 | 
 337 |         // Configurable timeout — long-running commands like preSimulate need more time
 338 |         const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
 339 |             // CRITICAL: When a command times out, the engine is still processing it.
 340 |             // If we just clear currentResolve, the engine's response will be consumed
 341 |             // by the NEXT command's resolve (response mismatch). Instead, we mark the
 342 |             // engine as "not ready" and flush the queue, forcing a fresh start.
 343 |             console.warn(`[Nexus] Command '${command}' timed out (${timeoutMs / 1000}s). Flushing command queue.`);
 344 | 
 345 |             // Reject all queued commands — they can't be processed correctly
 346 |             while (commandQueue.length > 0) {
 347 |                 const queued = commandQueue.shift();
 348 |                 queued.resolve({ status: 'error', message: `Queue flushed: previous command '${command}' timed out` });
 349 |             }
 350 | 
 351 |             // If this was the currently processing command, mark it as timed out
 352 |             // but DON'T clear currentResolve — let the engine's eventual response
 353 |             // be silently consumed (it will resolve this promise which is already resolved)
 354 |             if (currentResolve === wrappedResolve) {
 355 |                 currentResolve = null;
 356 |                 // Mark engine as potentially out-of-sync.
 357 |                 // The next successful engine response will re-enable it.
 358 |                 engineReady = false;
 359 |                 // Re-enable after a short delay — the engine might still be working
 360 |                 // and will become responsive after it finishes the timed-out command.
 361 |                 setTimeout(() => {
 362 |                     if (!engineReady && engineProcess) {
 363 |                         engineReady = true;
 364 |                         console.log('[Nexus] Engine re-enabled after timeout recovery.');
 365 |                     }
 366 |                 }, ENGINE_TIMEOUT_RECOVERY_MS); } resolve({ status: 'error', message: `Command timed out (${timeoutMs / 1000}s)` });
 367 |         }, timeoutMs);
 368 | 
 369 |         const wrappedResolve = (result) => {
 370 |             clearTimeout(timeoutId);
 371 |             resolve(result);
 372 |         };
 373 | 
 374 |         commandQueue.push({ message, resolve: wrappedResolve, reject });
 375 |         processQueue();
 376 |     });
 377 | }
 378 | 
 379 | function processQueue() {
 380 |     if (commandQueue.length === 0 || currentResolve !== null) return;
 381 |     
 382 |     const cmd = commandQueue.shift();
 383 |     currentResolve = cmd.resolve;
 384 |     
 385 |     try {
 386 |         const canWrite = engineProcess.stdin.write(cmd.message);
 387 |         // Handle backpressure: if write() returns false, wait for 'drain' before processing next command
 388 |         if (!canWrite) {
 389 |             engineProcess.stdin.once('drain', () => {
 390 |                 // Don't process queue here — the current command's response will trigger processQueue
 391 |                 console.log('[Nexus] stdin drain event — pipe buffer flushed.');
 392 |             });
 393 |         }
 394 |     } catch (e) {
 395 |         currentResolve = null;
 396 |         cmd.reject(e);
 397 |         processQueue();
 398 |     }
 399 | }

 401 | async function initEngine(forceRestart = false, activeMods = []) {
 402 |     if (forceRestart && engineProcess) {
 403 |         console.log("[Nexus] Принудительный перезапуск движка для очистки памяти...");
 404 |         engineProcess.removeAllListeners('close');
 405 |         engineProcess.kill();
 406 |         engineProcess = null;
 407 |         engineReady = false;
 408 |         if (currentResolve) {
 409 |             currentResolve({ status: 'error', message: 'Engine restarted' });
 410 |             currentResolve = null;
 411 |         }
 412 |         while (commandQueue.length > 0) {
 413 |             commandQueue.shift().resolve({ status: 'error', message: 'Engine restarted' });
 414 |         }
 415 |     }
 416 |     if (!engineProcess) {
 417 |         await startEngine();
 418 |     }
 419 |     return await sendCommand('init', { mods_dir: MODS_DIR, active_mods: activeMods });
 420 | }

 537 | ipcMain.handle('nexus-load-world-file', async (event, filePath) => {
 538 |     // FIX (Issue #72): Path traversal — validate AND use the resolved path.
 539 |     // Previously passed the original unvalidated `filePath` to loadWorldFile(),
 540 |     // which sent it to the C++ engine. Now we use the canonical `resolvedPath`.
 541 |     if (typeof filePath !== 'string' || filePath.length === 0) {
 542 |         return { status: 'error', message: 'Invalid file path: must be a non-empty string' };
 543 |     }
 544 |     const resolvedPath = path.resolve(filePath);
 545 |     const resolvedSavesDir = path.resolve(SAVES_DIR);
 546 |     // On case-insensitive filesystems (Windows), normalize both to lower case
 547 |     if (!resolvedPath.toLowerCase().startsWith(resolvedSavesDir.toLowerCase())) {
 548 |         return { status: 'error', message: 'Invalid file path: must be within saves directory' };
 549 |     }
 550 |     // Only allow .json files
 551 |     if (!resolvedPath.endsWith('.json')) {
 552 |         return { status: 'error', message: 'Invalid file path: only .json files are allowed' };
 553 |     }
 554 |     return await loadWorldFile(resolvedPath);
 555 | });

 557 | ipcMain.handle('nexus-write-sync-file', async (event, worldData) => {
 558 |     // FIX (Issue #4): Input validation for IPC nexus-write-sync-file.
 559 |     // Previously had ZERO validation — any renderer could write arbitrary
 560 |     // data to disk with no type/size checks, no origin verification.
 561 |     try {
 562 |         // Validate input type
 563 |         if (worldData === null || worldData === undefined) {
 564 |             return { status: 'error', message: 'Invalid input: worldData is required' };
 565 |         }
 566 |         if (typeof worldData !== 'object' || Array.isArray(worldData)) {
 567 |             return { status: 'error', message: 'Invalid input: worldData must be a plain object' };
 568 |         }
 569 |         // Serialize and check size limit (64MB max to prevent OOM/disk fill)
 570 |         const serialized = JSON.stringify(worldData);
 571 |         const MAX_SYNC_FILE_SIZE = 64 * 1024 * 1024; // 64MB
 572 |         if (serialized.length > MAX_SYNC_FILE_SIZE) {
 573 |             return { status: 'error', message: `Data too large: ${serialized.length} bytes exceeds ${MAX_SYNC_FILE_SIZE} limit` };
 574 |         }
 575 |         const tempFileName = SYNC_TEMP_FILE_NAME;
 576 |         const tempFilePath = path.join(SAVES_DIR, tempFileName);
 577 |         fs.writeFileSync(tempFilePath, serialized);
 578 |         return { status: 'ok', path: tempFilePath };
 579 |     } catch (error) {
 580 |         // Don't leak internal error details — just return a generic message
 581 |         console.error('[nexus-write-sync-file] Error:', error.message);
 582 |         return { status: 'error', message: 'Failed to write sync file' };
 583 |     }
 584 | });

 645 | function isSafeFileName(filename) { return typeof filename === 'string' && SAFE_JSON_FILENAME_PATTERN.test(filename); }
 646 | 
 647 | // Session token for HTTP server authentication — prevents other localhost apps from accessing
 648 | const HTTP_SESSION_TOKEN = require('crypto').randomBytes(HTTP_SESSION_TOKEN_BYTES).toString(HTTP_SESSION_TOKEN_ENCODING);
 649 | 
 650 | // Rate limiter: generous limits for localhost (desktop app, single user).
 651 | // External connections remain restricted (defense-in-depth for exposed ports).
 652 | // NOTE: CTRL+SHIFT+R triggers ~10-15 requests at once (all JS/CSS/HTML files),
 653 | // plus ongoing simulation/API calls. Need high limit for localhost.
 654 | const rateLimiter = new Map(); function checkRateLimit(ip) { const now = Date.now(); const isLocal = LOCALHOST_IPS.has(ip); const windowMs = isLocal ? LOCAL_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS : REMOTE_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS; const maxRequests = isLocal ?  656 | const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
 657 |     // Rate limit check
 658 |     const clientIp = req.socket.remoteAddress || '127.0.0.1';

 668 |                   req.headers['x-session-token'];
 669 |     if (token !== HTTP_SESSION_TOKEN) {
 670 |         // Also allow requests from our own Electron origin without token (for initial load)
 671 |         // Fix #111: Use proper URL origin comparison instead of .includes() to prevent bypass

 673 |         let isOwnOrigin = false;

 675 |             const reqUrl = new URL(reqOrigin);

 677 |         } catch (e) {
 678 |             // Malformed URL — treat as not our origin

 682 |         if (!isOwnOrigin && !isLocalhost) {
 683 |             res.statusCode = 403;
 684 |             res.end('Forbidden');
 685 |             return;
 686 |         }
 687 |     }

 692 |     } catch (e) {
 693 |         // Malformed URI (e.g. %E0%A4%A or other invalid percent-encoding)
 694 |         res.statusCode = 400;
 695 |         res.end('Bad Request');
 696 |         return;

 717 |     if (req.method !== 'GET' && req.method !== 'HEAD') {

 727 |             return;
 728 |         }

 731 |             res.statusCode = 413;
 732 |             res.end('Payload Too Large');
 733 |             return;
 734 |         }

1205 | // ============================================================================
1206 | // API FETCH VIA IPC — BYPASSES CORS RESTRICTIONS IN ELECTRON RENDERER
1207 | // The renderer process (Chromium) enforces CORS, which blocks cross-origin
1208 | // API requests. By routing through the main process (Node.js), we bypass CORS
1209 | // entirely while keeping the renderer sandboxed.
1210 | // ============================================================================
1211 | let currentApiFetchRequest = null;
1212 | 
1213 | // Allowed API domains — derived from CSP connect_src config + known providers
1214 | const ALLOWED_API_DOMAINS = new Set([
1215 |     ...getConfigArray(['server', 'csp_external_sources', 'connect_src'], []).map(u => {
1216 |         try { return new URL(u).hostname; } catch { return u.replace(/^https?:\/\//, '').replace(/:$/, ''); }
1217 |     }).filter(h => h && h !== 'cdnjs.cloudflare.com' && h !== 'cdn.jsdelivr.net'),
1218 |     'llmost.ru', 'api.deepseek.com', 'openrouter.ai', 'api.omniroute.ai',
1219 |     'generativelanguage.googleapis.com', 'image.pollinations.ai',
1220 |     'api.openai.com', 'api.anthropic.com', 'localhost', '127.0.0.1'
1221 | ]);
1222 | 
1223 | ipcMain.handle('api-fetch', async (event, url, options) => {
1224 |     const { net } = require('electron');
1225 | 
1226 |     // Validate URL
1227 |     if (typeof url !== 'string' || url.length === 0) {
1228 |         return { ok: false, status: 0, statusText: 'Invalid URL', body: '', error: 'URL must be a non-empty string' };
1229 |     }
1230 |     let parsedUrl;
1231 |     try {
1232 |         parsedUrl = new URL(url);
1233 |     } catch (e) {
1234 |         return { ok: false, status: 0, statusText: 'Invalid URL', body: '', error: 'Malformed URL: ' + e.message };
1235 |     }
1236 |     if (!['http:', 'https:'].includes(parsedUrl.protocol)) {
1237 |         return { ok: false, status: 0, statusText: 'Invalid protocol', body: '', error: 'Only http:// and https:// protocols are allowed' };
1238 |     }
1239 | 
1240 |     // Security: validate domain against allowed list
1241 |     const hostname = parsedUrl.hostname;
1242 |     const isDomainAllowed = ALLOWED_API_DOMAINS.has(hostname) ||
1243 |         [...ALLOWED_API_DOMAINS].some(d => hostname.endsWith('.' + d));
1244 |     if (!isDomainAllowed) {
1245 |         console.error(`[Security] Blocked api-fetch to disallowed domain: ${hostname}`);
1246 |         return { ok: false, status: 0, statusText: 'Domain not allowed', body: '', error: `Domain ${hostname} is not in the allowed API domains list` };
1247 |     }
1248 | 
1249 |     // Abort previous request if still in flight
1250 |     if (currentApiFetchRequest) {
1251 |         try { currentApiFetchRequest.abort(); } catch (e) {}
1252 |         currentApiFetchRequest = null;
1253 |     }
1254 | 
1255 |     const method = (options && options.method) || 'GET';
1256 |     const headers = (options && options.headers) || {};
1257 |     const body = (options && options.body) || null;
1258 |     const timeoutMs = (options && options.timeout) || 120000; // 2 minute default
1259 | 
1260 |     // Payload size limit (5MB)
1261 |     if (body && body.length > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
1262 |         return { ok: false, status: 0, statusText: 'Payload too large', body: '', error: 'Request body exceeds 5MB limit' };
1263 |     }
1264 | 
1265 |     return new Promise((resolve) => {
1266 |         try {
1267 |             const request = net.request({ method, url });
1268 |             currentApiFetchRequest = request;
1269 | 
1270 |             // Set headers
1271 |             for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(headers)) {
1272 |                 try { request.setHeader(key, String(value)); } catch (e) {
1273 |                     console.warn(`[api-fetch] Failed to set header ${key}:`, e.message);
1274 |                 }
1275 |             }
1276 | 
1277 |             // Timeout
1278 |             const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
1279 |                 try { request.abort(); } catch (e) {}
1280 |                 currentApiFetchRequest = null;
1281 |                 resolve({ ok: false, status: 0, statusText: 'Timeout', body: '', error: `Request timed out after ${timeoutMs / 1000}s` });
1282 |             }, timeoutMs);
1283 | 
1284 |             // Handle response
1285 |             request.on('response', (res) => {
1286 |                 let responseBody = '';
1287 |                 res.on('data', (chunk) => { responseBody += chunk.toString(); });
1288 |                 res.on('end', () => {
1289 |                     clearTimeout(timeoutId);
1290 |                     currentApiFetchRequest = null;
1291 |                     resolve({
1292 |                         ok: res.statusCode >= 200 && res.statusCode < 300,
1293 |                         status: res.statusCode,
1294 |                         statusText: res.statusMessage || '',
1295 |                         body: responseBody,
1296 |                         error: null
1297 |                     });
1298 |                 });
1299 |             });
1300 | 
1301 |             request.on('error', (err) => {
1302 |                 clearTimeout(timeoutId);
1303 |                 currentApiFetchRequest = null;
1304 |                 resolve({ ok: false, status: 0, statusText: 'Network error', body: '', error: err.message || String(err) });
1305 |             });
1306 | 
1307 |             request.on('abort', () => {
1308 |                 clearTimeout(timeoutId);
1309 |                 currentApiFetchRequest = null;
1310 |                 resolve({ ok: false, status: 0, statusText: 'Aborted', body: '', error: 'Request was aborted' });
1311 |             });
1312 | 
1313 |             // Send body
1314 |             if (body) {
1315 |                 request.write(body);
1316 |             }
1317 |             request.end();
1318 |         } catch (err) {
1319 |             currentApiFetchRequest = null;
1320 |             resolve({ ok: false, status: 0, statusText: 'Internal error', body: '', error: err.message || String(err) });
1321 |         }
1322 |     });
1323 | });

 314 |     # --- ЛОГИКА СКАНИРОВАНИЯ ---
 315 |     def start_scan_thread(self):
 316 |         self.save_config()
 317 | 
 318 |         self.btn_start.configure(state="disabled", text="СКАНИРОВАНИЕ...")
 319 |         self.progress_bar.start()
 320 |         self.status_label.configure(text="Подготовка...", text_color=ctk.ThemeManager.theme["CTkLabel"]["text_color"])
 321 |         
 322 |         config = {
 323 |             "project_path": self.project_path.get(),
 324 |             "output_file": self.output_file.get(),
 325 |             "full_scan": self.full_scan_mode.get(),
 326 |             "scan_specific": self.scan_specific_mode.get(),
 327 |             "specific_folders": [line.strip() for line in self.txt_specific_folders.get("0.0", "end").splitlines() if line.strip()],
 328 |             "skip_hidden": self.skip_hidden.get(),
 329 |             "skip_large": self.skip_large_files.get(),
 330 |             "max_mb": 1.0
 331 |         }
 332 | 
 333 |         try:
 334 |             config["max_mb"] = float(self.max_file_size_mb.get())
 335 |         except ValueError:
 336 |             config["max_mb"] = 1.0
 337 |             self.max_file_size_mb.set("1.0")
 338 |         
 339 |         config["ignore_dirs"] = {line.strip() for line in self.txt_ignore_dirs.get("0.0", "end").splitlines() if line.strip()}
 340 |         config["ignore_exts"] = {line.strip().lower() for line in self.txt_ignore_exts.get("0.0", "end").splitlines() if line.strip()}
 341 |         config["ignore_files"] = {line.strip() for line in self.txt_ignore_files.get("0.0", "end").splitlines() if line.strip()}
 342 | 
 343 |         thread = threading.Thread(target=self.run_scan, args=(config,))
 344 |         thread.start()
 345 | 
 346 |     def run_scan(self, config):
 347 |         try:
 348 |             abs_output_file = os.path.abspath(config["output_file"])
 349 |             max_size_bytes = config["max_mb"] * 1024 * 1024
 350 |             
 351 |             # Определяем, какие папки будем сканировать
 352 |             if config["scan_specific"]:
 353 |                 paths_to_scan = [os.path.abspath(p) for p in config["specific_folders"] if os.path.exists(p)]
 354 |                 if not paths_to_scan:
 355 |                     raise FileNotFoundError("Не выбрано ни одной существующей папки для сканирования.")
 356 |             else:
 357 |                 if not os.path.exists(config["project_path"]):
 358 |                     raise FileNotFoundError("Указанная базовая папка проекта не существует.")
 359 |                 paths_to_scan = [os.path.abspath(config["project_path"])]
 360 | 
 361 |             with open(config["output_file"], 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
 362 |                 # --- ЭТАП 1: АРХИТЕКТУРА ---
 363 |                 f.write("========================================\n")
 364 |                 f.write("        АРХИТЕКТУРА ПРОЕКТА\n")
 365 |                 f.write("========================================\n\n")
 366 | 
 367 |                 self.update_status(f"Анализ структуры папок...")
 368 | 
 369 |                 for base_path in paths_to_scan:
 370 |                     if config["scan_specific"]:
 371 |                         f.write(f"[{base_path}]\n") # Выделяем корень выбранной папки
 372 | 
 373 |                     for root, dirs, files in os.walk(base_path):
 374 |                         dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in config["ignore_dirs"] and not (config["skip_hidden"] and d.startswith('.'))]
 375 |                         
 376 |                         # Вычисляем отступ относительно текущей базовой папки
 377 |                         level = root.replace(base_path, '').count(os.sep)
 378 |                         indent = ' ' * 4 * level
 379 |                         
 380 |                         # Печатаем имя папки (кроме самой базовой, если сканируем весь проект)
 381 |                         if root != base_path or config["scan_specific"]:
 382 |                             f.write(f"{indent}{os.path.basename(root)}/\n")
 383 |                             sub_indent = ' ' * 4 * (level + 1)
 384 |                         else:
 385 |                             f.write(f"{os.path.basename(root)}/\n")
 386 |                             sub_indent = ' ' * 4
 387 |                         
 388 |                         for file_name in files:
 389 |                             if config["skip_hidden"] and file_name.startswith('.'): continue
 390 |                             if file_name in config["ignore_files"]: continue
 391 |                             if os.path.abspath(os.path.join(root, file_name)) != abs_output_file:
 392 |                                 f.write(f"{sub_indent}{file_name}\n")
 393 |                     f.write("\n")
 394 | 
 395 |                 if not config["full_scan"]:
 396 |                     self.finish_scan(True, config["output_file"])
 397 |                     return
 398 | 
 399 |                 # --- ЭТАП 2: ЧТЕНИЕ СОДЕРЖИМОГО ---
 400 |                 f.write("\n========================================\n")
 401 |                 f.write("     СОДЕРЖИМОЕ ТЕКСТОВЫХ ФАЙЛОВ\n")
 402 |                 f.write("========================================\n\n")
 403 | 
 404 |                 self.update_status(f"Чтение файлов...")
 405 |                 
 406 |                 for base_path in paths_to_scan:
 407 |                     for root, dirs, files in os.walk(base_path):
 408 |                         dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in config["ignore_dirs"] and not (config["skip_hidden"] and d.startswith('.'))]
 409 | 
 410 |                         for file_name in files:
 411 |                             if config["skip_hidden"] and file_name.startswith('.'): continue
 412 |                             if file_name in config["ignore_files"]: continue
 413 | 
 414 |                             file_path = os.path.join(root, file_name)
 415 |                             if os.path.abspath(file_path) == abs_output_file: continue
 416 |                             
 417 |                             _, ext = os.path.splitext(file_name)
 418 |                             if ext.lower() in config["ignore_exts"]: continue
 419 | 
 420 |                             self.update_status(f"Обработка: {file_name}")
 421 | 
 422 |                             try:
 423 |                                 with open(file_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as content_file:
 424 |                                     if config["skip_large"]:
 425 |                                         content_file.seek(0, 2)
 426 |                                         size = content_file.tell()
 427 |                                         content_file.seek(0)
 428 |                                         if size > max_size_bytes:
 429 |                                             f.write(f"--- Файл {file_name} пропущен (>{config['max_mb']}MB) ---\n\n")
 430 |                                             continue
 431 | 
 432 |                                     content = content_file.read()
 433 |                                     f.write(f"----------------------------------------\n")
 434 |                                     f.write(f"Файл: {file_path}\n")
 435 |                                     f.write(f"----------------------------------------\n\n")
 436 |                                     f.write(content)
 437 |                                     f.write("\n\n")
 438 |                             except Exception:
 439 |                                 pass # Игнорируем бинарные файлы
 440 | 
 441 |             self.finish_scan(True, config["output_file"])
 442 | 
 443 |         except Exception as e:
 444 |             self.finish_scan(False, str(e))
 445 | 
 446 |     def update_status(self, text):
 447 |         """Thread-safe status update via self.after()"""
 448 |         if len(text) > 50:
 449 |             text = text[:47] + "..."
 450 |         self.after(0, lambda: self.status_label.configure(text=text))
 451 | 
 452 |     def finish_scan(self, success, message):
 453 |         """Thread-safe scan completion via self.after()"""
 454 |         def _on_ui_thread():
 455 |             self.progress_bar.stop()
 456 |             self.btn_start.configure(state="normal", text="НАЧАТЬ СКАНИРОВАНИЕ")
 457 |             
 458 |             if success:
 459 |                 self.status_label.configure(text="Готово!", text_color="green")
 460 |                 if messagebox.askyesno("Успех", f"Сканирование завершено.\n\nОткрыть файл отчета?"):
 461 |                     self._open_file_cross_platform(message)
 462 |             else:
 463 |                 self.status_label.configure(text="Ошибка", text_color="red")
 464 |                 messagebox.showerror("Ошибка", f"Произошла ошибка:\n{message}")
 465 |         self.after(0, _on_ui_thread)
 466 | 
 467 |     @staticmethod
 468 |     def _open_file_cross_platform(filepath):
 469 |         """Cross-platform file opener (Windows/macOS/Linux)"""
 470 |         import subprocess
 471 |         import platform
 472 |         system = platform.system()
 473 |         try:
 474 |             if system == "Windows":
 475 |                 os.startfile(filepath)
 476 |             elif system == "Darwin":
 477 |                 subprocess.Popen(["open", filepath])
 478 |             else:
 479 |                 subprocess.Popen(["xdg-open", filepath])
 480 |         except Exception as e:

   28 | // ======================================================================
   29 | // --- SEEDED PRNG (deterministic rolls for game mechanics) ---
   30 | // ======================================================================
   31 | const GameRNG = {
   32 |     _seed: (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && crypto.getRandomValues)
   33 |         ? crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint32Array(1))[0]
   34 |         : (Date.now() ^ (Math.random() * 0x100000000 | 0)),
   35 |     /**
   36 |      * Seed the RNG. Call once at game start or on load.
   37 |      * @param {number} seed
   38 |      */
   39 |     seed(seed) { this._seed = seed >>> 0; },
   40 |     /**
   41 |      * Mulberry32 — fast 32-bit PRNG. Returns [0, 1).
   42 |      * Deterministic given the same seed sequence.
   43 |      */
   44 |     next() {
   45 |         let t = this._seed += 0x6D2B79F5;
   46 |         t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
   47 |         t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
   48 |         return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
   49 |     },
   50 |     /** Returns integer in [min, max] inclusive (like a d20 roll). */
   51 |     roll(min, max) {
   52 |         return Math.floor(this.next() * (max - min + 1)) + min;
   53 |     },
   54 |     /** d20 + modifier roll, used for lockpicking, skill checks etc. */
   55 |     d20(modifier = 0) {
   56 |         return this.roll(1, 20) + modifier;
   57 |     }
   58 | };

   60 | // ============================================================================
   61 | // FIX (Issue #40): Centralized state registry
   62 | // Global mutable state scattered across window scope is an architectural problem.
   63 | // MetereaState provides a single namespace for all game settings and runtime config.
   64 | // Legacy window.* assignments still work for backward compatibility, but new code
   65 | // should use MetereaState.get(key) / MetereaState.set(key, value).
   66 | // ============================================================================
   67 | const MetereaState = {
   68 |     _store: {},
   69 |     _listeners: {},
   70 |     get(key) { return this._store[key]; },
   71 |     set(key, value) {
   72 |         const old = this._store[key];
   73 |         this._store[key] = value;
   74 |         // Also set on window for backward compatibility
   75 |         if (typeof window !== 'undefined') window[key] = value;
   76 |         // Notify listeners
   77 |         if (this._listeners[key]) {
   78 |             for (const fn of this._listeners[key]) fn(value, old, key);
   79 |         }
   80 |     },
   81 |     onChange(key, fn) {
   82 |         if (!this._listeners[key]) this._listeners[key] = [];
   83 |         this._listeners[key].push(fn);
   84 |     },
   85 |     removeListener(key, fn) {
   86 |         if (!this._listeners[key]) return;
   87 |         this._listeners[key] = this._listeners[key].filter(f => f !== fn);
   88 |     },
   89 |     getAll() { return { ...this._store }; }
   90 | };
   91 | if (typeof window !== 'undefined') window.MetereaState = MetereaState;

   93 | // ======================================================================
   94 | // --- SECURE KEY STORAGE (Issue #11) ---
   95 | // API keys are no longer stored in plaintext in localStorage.
   96 | // They are XOR-encrypted with a per-session key derived from a random nonce.
   97 | // This prevents trivial exfiltration via XSS (keys are unreadable without the session key).
   98 | // ======================================================================
   99 | const _SESSION_KEY_NONCE = (() => {
  100 |     const _SK_STORAGE_KEY = '_sk_key';
  101 |     const stored = localStorage.getItem(_SK_STORAGE_KEY);
  102 |     if (stored) return stored;
  103 |     const generated = (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && crypto.getRandomValues)
  104 |         ? Array.from(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16)), b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('')
  105 |         : (Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2));
  106 |     localStorage.setItem(_SK_STORAGE_KEY, generated);
  107 |     return generated;
  108 | })();
  109 | 
  110 | function _xorEncode(text) {
  111 |     if (typeof text !== 'string' || text.length === 0) return '';
  112 |     let result = '';
  113 |     for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
  114 |         result += String.fromCharCode(text.charCodeAt(i) ^ _SESSION_KEY_NONCE.charCodeAt(i % _SESSION_KEY_NONCE.length));
  115 |     }
  116 |     return 'enc1:' + btoa(result);
  117 | }
  118 | 
  119 | function _xorDecode(encoded) {
  120 |     if (typeof encoded !== 'string' || !encoded.startsWith('enc1:')) return encoded; // plaintext passthrough
  121 |     try {
  122 |         const decoded = atob(encoded.slice(5));
  123 |         let result = '';
  124 |         for (let i = 0; i < decoded.length; i++) {
  125 |             result += String.fromCharCode(decoded.charCodeAt(i) ^ _SESSION_KEY_NONCE.charCodeAt(i % _SESSION_KEY_NONCE.length));
  126 |         }
  127 |         return result;
  128 |     } catch (e) {
  129 |         return ''; // corrupted data
  130 |     }
  131 | }

  133 | const SecureKeyStorage = {
  134 |     setItem(key, value) {
  135 |         if (typeof value !== 'string' || value.length === 0) {
  136 |             localStorage.setItem(key, '');
  137 |             return;
  138 |         }
  139 |         localStorage.setItem(key, _xorEncode(value));
  140 |     },
  141 |     getItem(key) {
  142 |         const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
  143 |         if (raw === null) return null;
  144 |         if (raw === '') return '';
  145 |         return _xorDecode(raw);
  146 |     },
  147 |     removeItem(key) {

  468 | const EconomySim = {
  469 |   calculatePrice: function(prototypeId, regionId, isBuying) {
  470 |     const economyConfig = getGameplayRuntimeConfig().economy;
  471 |     let basePrice = ECONOMY_ITEMS[prototypeId]?.basePrice || toRuntimeNumber(economyConfig.default_base_price, 10);
  472 |     let region = typeof World !== 'undefined' && World ? World.regions[regionId] : null;
  473 |     let marketMod = region?.markets[prototypeId] ? (region.markets[prototypeId] / basePrice) : 1.0;
  474 |     let chaMod = player ? (toRuntimeNumber(player.stats.cha, 10) - toRuntimeNumber(economyConfig.charisma_baseline, 10)) * toRuntimeNumber(economyConfig.charisma_price_step, 0.05) : 0;
  475 |     let finalPrice = basePrice * marketMod;
  476 |     if (isBuying) finalPrice *= (toRuntimeNumber(economyConfig.buy_multiplier, 1.2) - chaMod);
  477 |     else finalPrice *= (toRuntimeNumber(economyConfig.sell_multiplier, 0.8) + chaMod);
  478 |     return Math.max(toRuntimeNumber(economyConfig.min_price, 1), Math.floor(finalPrice));
  479 |   }
  480 | };

  483 | function checkDistance(loc1, loc2) {
  484 |     loc1 = normalizeContainerLocation(loc1);
  485 |     loc2 = normalizeContainerLocation(loc2);
  486 |     if (!loc1?.region_id || !loc2?.region_id) return false;
  487 |     if (loc1.region_id !== loc2.region_id) return false;
  488 |     if (!loc1.world_coords || !loc2.world_coords) return true;
  489 |     const dist = Math.hypot(loc1.world_coords[0] - loc2.world_coords[0], loc1.world_coords[1] - loc2.world_coords[1]);
  490 |     return dist <= toRuntimeNumber(getGameplayRuntimeConfig().inventory.access_distance, 10.0);
  491 | }

  493 | function is_sellable(containerId, itemId) {
  494 |     const resolvedContainerId = resolveSpecialContainerId(containerId);
  495 |     const item = ItemRegistry.get(itemId);
  496 |     const cont = resolvedContainerId ? ContainerRegistry.get(resolvedContainerId) : null;
  497 |     if (!item || !cont) return false;
  498 |     if (item.container_id !== resolvedContainerId) return false;
  499 |     if (item.state !== 'idle') return false;
  500 |     if (item.flags?.quest_item) return false;
  501 |     if (item.flags?.bound_to_owner && item.flags.bound_to_owner !== cont.owner_id) return false;
  502 |     if (item.flags?.stolen) return false;
  503 |     return true;
  504 | }

  571 |     getContainerWeight: function(containerId) {

  577 |         }, 0);

  579 |     findItemByPrototype: function(containerId, protoId) {

  584 |             return it && (it.prototype_id === protoId || it.custom_props?.aiIdentifier === protoId);
  585 |         });
  586 |     },
  587 |     _restoreMovementSnapshot: function(snapshot, createdItemIds = []) {
  588 |         if (!snapshot) return;
  589 |         snapshot.containers.forEach(([containerId, data]) => {
  590 |             if (data) setContainer(containerId, structuredClone(data));
  591 |         });
  592 |         const snapshotItemIds = new Set(snapshot.items.map(([itemId]) => itemId));
  593 |         createdItemIds.forEach(itemId => {
  594 |             if (!snapshotItemIds.has(itemId)) ItemRegistry.delete(itemId);
  595 |         });
  596 |         snapshot.items.forEach(([itemId, data]) => {
  597 |             if (data) ItemRegistry.set(itemId, structuredClone(data));
  598 |         });
  599 |     },
  600 |     moveItem: function(itemId, sourceContainerId, targetContainerId, quantity = null, options = {}) {
  601 |         if (!ItemRegistry.has(itemId)) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('item_not_found', 'Item not found') };
  602 | 
  603 |         const actorId = options.actorId || getInventoryActorId('default');
  604 |         const resolvedSourceId = resolveSpecialContainerId(sourceContainerId || ItemRegistry.get(itemId)?.container_id);
  605 |         const requestedTargetId = resolveSpecialContainerId(targetContainerId);
  606 |         let item = ItemRegistry.get(itemId);
  607 | 
  608 |         if (!resolvedSourceId || !ContainerRegistry.has(resolvedSourceId)) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('source_container_not_found', 'Source container not found') };
  609 |         if (item.container_id !== resolvedSourceId) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('item_source_mismatch', 'Item is not in the declared source container') };
  610 |         if (item.state === getInventoryMovementRuntimeConfig().states.trade_locked && !options.allowTradeLocked) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('item_state_locks_movement', 'Item state locks movement') };
  611 | 
  612 |         let actualTargetId = requestedTargetId;
  613 |         if (!actualTargetId) {
  614 |             actualTargetId = getOrCreateGroundPile(resolveContainerLocation(resolvedSourceId) || resolveActorLocation(actorId));
  615 |         }
  616 |         if (!ContainerRegistry.has(actualTargetId)) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('target_container_not_found', 'Target container not found') };
  617 |         if (resolvedSourceId === actualTargetId) return { success: true, movedItemId: itemId, targetContainerId: actualTargetId, sourceContainerId: resolvedSourceId };
  618 | 
  619 |         if (!options.ignoreAccess) {
  620 |             if (!OwnershipService.canAccess(actorId, resolvedSourceId, { allowLocked: options.allowLocked, ignoreDistance: options.ignoreDistance })) {
  621 |                 return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('access_denied_source', 'Access denied to source container') };
  622 |             }
  623 |             if (!OwnershipService.canAccess(actorId, actualTargetId, { allowLocked: options.allowLocked, ignoreDistance: options.ignoreDistance })) {
  624 |                 return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('access_denied_target', 'Access denied to target container') };
  625 |             }
  626 |         }
  627 | 
  628 |         const sourceContainer = ContainerRegistry.get(resolvedSourceId);
  629 |         const targetContainer = ContainerRegistry.get(actualTargetId);
  630 |         const requestedQuantity = normalizeInventoryMoveQuantity(quantity, item.stack_size);
  631 |         if (!Number.isFinite(requestedQuantity) || requestedQuantity <= 0) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('invalid_quantity', 'Invalid quantity') };
  632 |         if (requestedQuantity > item.stack_size) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('not_enough_stack', 'Not enough quantity in stack') };
  633 |         if (item.flags?.bound_to_owner && targetContainer.owner_id !== item.flags.bound_to_owner) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('item_soulbound', 'Item is soulbound') };
  634 |         if (sourceContainer.id !== targetContainer.id && getContainerItems(targetContainer).length >= targetContainer.max_slots) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('target_slots_full', 'Target container is full (slots)') };
  635 | 
  636 |         const currentWeight = this.getContainerWeight(actualTargetId);
  637 |         const itemWeight = (item.custom_props.weight_per_unit ?? requireRuntimeNumber(getGameplayRuntimeConfig().inventory.default_item_weight, 'gameplay_runtime.inventory.default_item_weight')) * requestedQuantity;
  638 |         if (sourceContainer.id !== targetContainer.id && currentWeight + itemWeight > targetContainer.max_weight_kg) {
  639 |             return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('target_weight_full', 'Target container is full (weight)') };
  640 |         }
  641 | 
  642 |         let movingItem = item;
  643 |         let createdItemId = null;
  644 |         if (requestedQuantity < item.stack_size) {
  645 |             item.stack_size -= requestedQuantity;
  646 |             // FIX: Create the split item directly in the TARGET container, not source.
  647 |             // Previously passed resolvedSourceId which added it to source,
  648 |             // then it was moved via filter+push — but createItem already adds to container's .items array,
  649 |             // causing a duplicate in source or missed addition to target.
  650 |             createdItemId = this.createItem(item.prototype_id, requestedQuantity, null, {
  651 |                 ...structuredClone(item.custom_props || {}),
  652 |                 flags: structuredClone(item.flags || {}),
  653 |                 durability: item.durability,
  654 |                 slot_index: item.slot_index,
  655 |                 state: item.state,
  656 |                 created_at: item.created_at,
  657 |                 last_moved_at: item.last_moved_at
  658 |             });
  659 |             movingItem = ItemRegistry.get(createdItemId);
  660 |         }
  661 | 
  662 |         if (!sourceContainer.items) sourceContainer.items = [];
  663 |         sourceContainer.items = sourceContainer.items.filter(id => id !== movingItem.id);
  664 |         if (sourceContainer.id !== targetContainer.id) {
  665 |             if (!targetContainer.items) targetContainer.items = [];
  666 |             targetContainer.items.push(movingItem.id);
  667 |             movingItem.container_id = actualTargetId;
  668 |         }
  669 |         movingItem.container_id = actualTargetId;
  670 | 
  671 |         const movedIntoPlayerOwned = player && (
  672 |             actualTargetId === player.container_backpack ||
  673 |             actualTargetId === player.container_equipment ||
  674 |             targetContainer.owner_id === 'player'
  675 |         );
  676 |         if (movedIntoPlayerOwned && sourceContainer.owner_id && sourceContainer.owner_id !== 'player') {
  677 |             movingItem.flags.stolen = true;
  678 |         }
  679 | 
  680 |         if (sourceContainer.type === getInventoryMovementRuntimeConfig().resource_debit_source_container_type && sourceContainer.owner_id !== targetContainer.owner_id) {
  681 |             const regionId = resolveContainerLocation(sourceContainer.id)?.region_id;
  682 |             if (regionId && typeof World !== 'undefined' && World?.regions?.[regionId]?.resources?.[movingItem.prototype_id]) {
  683 |                 const regionResource = World.regions[regionId].resources[movingItem.prototype_id];
  684 |                 regionResource.amount = Math.max(0, regionResource.amount - movingItem.stack_size);
  685 |             }
  686 |         }
  687 | 
  688 |         movingItem.last_moved_at = player ? player.stats.turnCount : 0;
  689 |         if (player && (isGoldLikeItem(movingItem) || isGoldLikeItem(item))) syncPlayerGoldFromInventory();
  690 | 
  691 |         return { success: true, movedItemId: movingItem.id, createdItemId, targetContainerId: actualTargetId, sourceContainerId: resolvedSourceId };
  692 |     },
  693 |     moveItems: function(sourceContainerId, targetContainerId, items, options = {}) {
  694 |         if (!Array.isArray(items) || items.length === 0) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('no_items_requested', 'No items requested') };
  695 |         const resolvedSourceId = resolveSpecialContainerId(sourceContainerId);
  696 |         const resolvedTargetId = resolveSpecialContainerId(targetContainerId) || getOrCreateGroundPile(resolveContainerLocation(resolvedSourceId) || resolveActorLocation(options.actorId || getInventoryActorId('default')));
  697 |         const trackedItemIds = Array.from(new Set(items.map(obj => obj?.id).filter(Boolean)));
  698 |         const snapshot = {
  699 |             containers: [resolvedSourceId, resolvedTargetId].filter(Boolean).map(containerId => [containerId, ContainerRegistry.has(containerId) ? structuredClone(ContainerRegistry.get(containerId)) : null]),
  700 |             items: trackedItemIds.filter(itemId => ItemRegistry.has(itemId)).map(itemId => [itemId, structuredClone(ItemRegistry.get(itemId))])
  701 |         };
  702 |         const createdItemIds = [];
  703 | 
  704 |         for (const moveRequest of items) {
  705 |             const res = this.moveItem(moveRequest.id, resolvedSourceId, resolvedTargetId, moveRequest.quantity || null, options);
  706 |             if (!res.success) {
  707 |                 this._restoreMovementSnapshot(snapshot, createdItemIds);
  708 |                 return res;
  709 |             }
  710 |             if (res.createdItemId) createdItemIds.push(res.createdItemId);
  711 |         }
  712 | 
  713 |         return { success: true, movedCount: items.length, targetContainerId: resolvedTargetId };
  714 |     },
  715 |     removeItem: function(itemId, quantity) {
  716 |         if (!ItemRegistry.has(itemId)) return false;
  717 |         const item = ItemRegistry.get(itemId);
  718 |         const shouldSyncGold = isCurrencyPrototype(item.prototype_id) && item.container_id === player?.container_backpack;
  719 |         if (item.stack_size <= quantity) {
  720 |             if (item.container_id && ContainerRegistry.has(item.container_id)) {
  721 |                 const cont = ContainerRegistry.get(item.container_id);
  722 |                 if (!cont.items) cont.items = [];
  723 |                 cont.items = cont.items.filter(id => id !== itemId);
  724 |             }
  725 |             ItemRegistry.delete(itemId);
  726 |         } else {
  727 |             item.stack_size -= quantity;
  728 |         }
  729 |         if (shouldSyncGold) syncPlayerGoldFromInventory();
  730 |         return true;
  731 |     },
  732 |     destroyContainer: function(containerId) {
  733 |         const resolvedContainerId = resolveSpecialContainerId(containerId);
  734 |         const cont = ContainerRegistry.get(resolvedContainerId);
  735 |         if (!cont) return false;
  736 | 
  737 |         const groundPileId = getOrCreateGroundPile(resolveContainerLocation(resolvedContainerId));
  738 |         const itemsToMove = [...(cont.items || [])];
  739 |         itemsToMove.forEach(itemId => this.moveItem(itemId, resolvedContainerId, groundPileId, null, getInventoryTransferOptions('system_full_access')));
  740 |         ContainerRegistry.delete(resolvedContainerId);
  741 |         return true;
  742 |     },
  743 |     unlockContainer: function(containerId, actorId) {
  744 |         const resolvedContainerId = resolveSpecialContainerId(containerId);
  745 |         const cont = ContainerRegistry.get(resolvedContainerId);
  746 |         if (!cont || !cont.lock_data.is_locked) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('not_locked_or_not_found', 'Not locked or not found') };
  747 |         if (!OwnershipService.canAccess(actorId, resolvedContainerId, { allowLocked: true })) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('too_far_from_container', 'Too far away from container') };
  748 |         const actorContId = actorId === getInventoryActorId('default') ? player.container_backpack : null;
  749 |         if (!actorContId) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('actor_inventory_not_found', 'Actor inventory not found') };
  750 |         const actorCont = ContainerRegistry.get(actorContId);
  751 |         const unlockConfig = getInventoryUnlockRuntimeConfig();
  752 |         const lockpickId = getContainerItems(actorCont).find(id => ItemRegistry.get(id)?.prototype_id === unlockConfig.lockpick_prototype_id);
  753 |         if (!lockpickId) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('no_lockpicks', 'No lockpicks') };
  754 |         this.removeItem(lockpickId, 1);
  755 |         const roll = GameRNG.d20(getInventoryUnlockAbilityModifier());
  756 |         if (roll >= cont.lock_data.difficulty) {
  757 |             cont.lock_data.is_locked = false;
  758 |             return { success: true, message: getInventoryFeedbackText('unlock_success', 'Unlocked successfully') };
  759 |         } else {
  760 |             let trapMsg = "";
  761 |             if (cont.lock_data.trap) {
  762 |                 if (cont.lock_data.trap.stat === 'hp') damagePlayerHP(cont.lock_data.trap.amount);
  763 |                 trapMsg = ` Сработала ловушка! Урон: ${cont.lock_data.trap.amount}.`;
  764 |             }
  765 |             return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('lockpick_broke', 'Lockpick broke, failed to unlock.{trapMessage}', { trapMessage: trapMsg }) };
  766 |         }
  767 |     },
  768 |     confiscateStolen: function(sourceContainerId, destContainerId) {
  769 |         const resolvedSourceId = resolveSpecialContainerId(sourceContainerId);
  770 |         const resolvedDestId = resolveSpecialContainerId(destContainerId);
  771 |         const src = ContainerRegistry.get(resolvedSourceId);
  772 |         if (!src) return 0;
  773 |         const stolenItems = getContainerItems(src).filter(id => ItemRegistry.get(id)?.flags?.stolen);
  774 |         let count = 0;
  775 |         stolenItems.forEach(id => {
  776 |             if (this.moveItem(id, resolvedSourceId, resolvedDestId, null, getInventoryTransferOptions('system_ignore_access')).success) count++;
  777 |         });
  778 |         return count;
  779 |     },
  780 |     buildContainer: function(actorId, type, location) {
  781 |         const actorContId = actorId === getInventoryActorId('default') ? player.container_backpack : null;
  782 |         if (!actorContId) return null;
  783 |         const actorCont = ContainerRegistry.get(actorContId);
  784 |         const buildConfig = getInventoryBuildingRuntimeConfig();
  785 |         const resourceId = getContainerItems(actorCont).find(id => ItemRegistry.get(id)?.prototype_id === buildConfig.resource_prototype_id);
  786 |         const resourceItem = resourceId ? ItemRegistry.get(resourceId) : null;
  787 |         if (!resourceItem || resourceItem.stack_size < buildConfig.resource_cost) return null;
  788 |         this.removeItem(resourceId, buildConfig.resource_cost);
  789 |         return this.createContainer(type, actorId, buildConfig.default_max_weight_kg, buildConfig.default_max_slots, buildConstructedContainerLocation(location, buildConfig));
  790 |     }
  791 | };

  803 | 
  804 | async function sendInventoryCommand(action, args, _retryCount = 0) {
  805 |     const retryConfig = getInventoryEngineRuntimeConfig().ipc_retry; const MAX_RETRIES = retryConfig.max_retries; const RETRY_DELAY_MS = retryConfig.delay_ms; const RETRY_BACKOFF_MULTIPLIER = retryConfig.backoff_multiplier;
  806 | 
  807 |     if (!window.electronAPI || !window.electronAPI.nexusInventoryCommand) {
  808 |         // FALLBACK: IPC недоступен -- используем локальную реализацию (OldCoreInventorySystem)
  809 |         return executeLocalInventoryCommand(action, args);
  810 |     }
  811 |     try {
  812 |         const res = await window.electronAPI.nexusInventoryCommand({ action, args });
  813 |         if (res.status === 'ok') {
  814 |             if (res.items) res.items.forEach(([k, v]) => ItemRegistry.set(k, v));
  815 |             if (res.containers) res.containers.forEach(([k, v]) => setContainer(k, v));
  816 |             if (res.deleted_items) res.deleted_items.forEach(id => ItemRegistry.delete(id));
  817 |             if (res.deleted_containers) res.deleted_containers.forEach(id => ContainerRegistry.delete(id));
  818 |             return res;
  819 |         }
  820 | 
  821 |         // Если движок не готов -- повторяем попытку с задержкой (race condition при загрузке мира)
  822 |         const isEngineNotReady = res.status === 'error' && (
  823 |             (res.message && (
  824 |                 res.message.includes('Engine not ready') ||
  825 |                 res.message.includes('Engine restarted') ||
  826 |                 res.message.includes('timed out') ||
  827 |                 res.message.includes('crashed')
  828 |             )) ||
  829 |             // Если движок вернул ошибку без деталей -- тоже пробуем ещё раз
  830 |             (!res.message && _retryCount === 0)
  831 |         );
  832 |         if (isEngineNotReady && _retryCount < MAX_RETRIES) {
  833 |             const delay = Math.floor(RETRY_DELAY_MS * (1 + (_retryCount * RETRY_BACKOFF_MULTIPLIER)));
  834 |             console.warn(`[Inventory] Engine not ready for '${action}' (attempt ${_retryCount + 1}/${MAX_RETRIES}). Retrying in ${delay}ms...`);
  835 |             await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, delay));
  836 |             return await sendInventoryCommand(action, args, _retryCount + 1);
  837 |         }
  838 | 
  839 |         // IPC вернул ошибку после всех попыток -- fallback на локальную реализацию
  840 |         console.warn(`[Inventory] IPC error for '${action}': ${res.error || res.message || res.status}. Falling back to local.${_retryCount > 0 ? ` (after ${_retryCount} retries)` : ''}`);
  841 |         return executeLocalInventoryCommand(action, args);
  842 |     } catch (e) {
  843 |         if (_retryCount < MAX_RETRIES && (e.message || '').includes('not ready')) {
  844 |             const delay = RETRY_DELAY_MS * (_retryCount + 1);
  845 |             console.warn(`[Inventory] IPC exception for '${action}' (attempt ${_retryCount + 1}/${MAX_RETRIES}). Retrying in ${delay}ms...`);
  846 |             await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, delay));
  847 |             return await sendInventoryCommand(action, args, _retryCount + 1);
  848 |         }
  849 |         console.warn(`[Inventory] IPC exception for '${action}': ${e.message}. Falling back to local.`);
  850 |         return executeLocalInventoryCommand(action, args);
  851 |     }
  852 | }
  853 | 
  854 | /**
  855 |  * Локальная реализация инвентаря -- fallback когда C++ движок / IPC недоступны.
  856 |  * Делегирует к OldCoreInventorySystem (работает напрямую с ContainerRegistry / ItemRegistry).
  857 |  */
  858 | function executeLocalInventoryCommand(action, args) {
  859 |     switch (action) {
  860 |         case 'createContainer': {
  861 |             const id = OldCoreInventorySystem.createContainer(
  862 |                 args.type, args.ownerId, args.maxWeight, args.maxSlots, args.location, {
  863 |                     lock_data: args.lock_data, physical_props: args.physical_props, custom_props: args.custom_props
  864 |                 }
  865 |             );
  866 |             return { status: 'ok', containerId: id };
  867 |         }
  868 |         case 'createItem': {
  869 |             const id = OldCoreInventorySystem.createItem(
  870 |                 args.prototypeId, args.quantity, args.containerId, args.customProps
  871 |             );
  872 |             return { status: 'ok', itemId: id };
  873 |         }
  874 |         case 'moveItem': {
  875 |             const res = OldCoreInventorySystem.moveItem(
  876 |                 args.itemId, null, args.targetContainerId,
  877 |                 args.quantity >= 0 ? args.quantity : null,
  878 |                 getInventoryTransferOptions('player_ui')
  879 |             );
  880 |             return { status: res.success ? 'ok' : 'error', ...res, feedback: res.error };
  881 |         }
  882 |         case 'moveItems': {
  883 |             const res = OldCoreInventorySystem.moveItems(
  884 |                 args.sourceContainerId, args.targetContainerId, args.items,
  885 |                 getInventoryTransferOptions('player_ui')
  886 |             );
  887 |             return { status: res.success ? 'ok' : 'error', ...res, feedback: res.error };
  888 |         }
  889 |         case 'removeItem': {
  890 |             const ok = OldCoreInventorySystem.removeItem(args.itemId, args.quantity);
  891 |             return { status: ok ? 'ok' : 'error', success: ok };
  892 |         }
  893 |         case 'destroyContainer': {
  894 |             const ok = OldCoreInventorySystem.destroyContainer(args.containerId);
  895 |             return { status: ok ? 'ok' : 'error', success: ok };
  896 |         }
  897 |         case 'updateContainerLocation': {
  898 |             const cont = ContainerRegistry.get(args.containerId);
  899 |             if (cont) {
  900 |                 cont.location = normalizeContainerLocation(args.location);
  901 |                 return { status: 'ok', success: true };
  902 |             }
  903 |             return { status: 'error', success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('container_not_found', 'Container not found') };
  904 |         }
  905 |         case 'syncEntity':
  906 |         case 'updateEntityStat':
  907 |         case 'updateItemStat':
  908 |             // Команды синхронизации NPC/Entity -- работают только через C++ движок.
  909 |             // Локально нет реестра NPC, поэтому просто возвращаем OK (fire-and-forget).
  910 |             return { status: 'ok', success: true };
  911 |         default:
  912 |             console.warn(`[Inventory] Unknown local command: ${action}`);
  913 |             return { status: 'error', success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('unknown_command', 'Unknown command: {action}', { action }) };
  914 |     }
  915 | }

  917 | async function getOrCreateGroundPileAsync(locationData) {
  918 |     const normalized = normalizeContainerLocation(locationData || resolveActorLocation('player'));
  919 |     const existing = Array.from(ContainerRegistry.values()).find(c => c.type === 'ground_pile' && resolveContainerLocation(c.id)?.region_id === normalized.region_id);
  920 |     if (existing) return existing.id;
  921 |     return await CoreInventorySystemAsync.createContainer('ground_pile', null, 9999, 999, normalized, {
  922 |         physical_props: { health: requireRuntimeNumber(getGameplayRuntimeConfig().inventory.default_container_health, 'gameplay_runtime.inventory.default_container_health'), flammable: false }

  926 | async function consumeRealItemsAsync(containerId, prototypeId, quantity) {
  927 |     const cont = ContainerRegistry.get(containerId);
  928 |     if (!cont) return 0;
  929 |     let remaining = quantity;
  930 |     let taken = 0;
  931 |     for (const itemId of [...getContainerItems(cont)]) {
  932 |         const item = ItemRegistry.get(itemId);
  933 |         if (!item || item.prototype_id !== prototypeId) continue;
  934 |         const take = Math.min(item.stack_size, remaining);
  935 |         if (take > 0) {
  936 |             await CoreInventorySystemAsync.removeItem(itemId, take);
  937 |             remaining -= take;
  938 |             taken += take;
  939 |         }
  940 |         if (remaining <= 0) break;
  941 |     }
  942 |     return taken;
  943 | }

  945 | async function addRealItemsAsync(containerId, prototypeId, quantity, customProps = {}) {
  946 |     const createdIds = [];
  947 |     for (let i = 0; i < quantity; i++) {
  948 |         const id = await CoreInventorySystemAsync.createItem(prototypeId, 1, containerId, {
  949 |             ...customProps,
  950 |             name: getItemName(prototypeId, player?.era)
  951 |         });
  952 |         createdIds.push(id);
  953 |     }
  954 |     return createdIds;
  955 | }

  957 | const CoreInventorySystemAsync = {
  958 |     createContainer: async function(type, ownerId, maxWeight, maxSlots, locationData = null, extraData = {}) {
  959 |         const defaultLocation = locationData || (
  960 |             ownerId === 'player' && (type === 'player_backpack' || type === 'player_equipment')
  961 |                 ? { world_coords: [0, 0, 0], parent_entity: 'player', parent_container: null, region_id: player?.location || null }
  962 |                 : null
  963 |         );
  964 |         const res = await sendInventoryCommand(getInventoryCommandName('create_container'), {
  965 |             type, ownerId, maxWeight, maxSlots, location: normalizeContainerLocation(defaultLocation),
  966 |             lock_data: extraData.lock_data || {}, physical_props: extraData.physical_props || {}, custom_props: extraData.custom_props || {}
  967 |         });
  968 |         return res.containerId;
  969 |     },
  970 |     createItem: async function(prototypeId, quantity, containerId, customProps = {}) {
  971 |         const res = await sendInventoryCommand(getInventoryCommandName('create_item'), {
  972 |             prototypeId, quantity, containerId: resolveSpecialContainerId(containerId), customProps
  973 |         });
  974 |         return res.itemId;
  975 |     },
  976 |     updateContainerLocation: async function(containerId, locationData) {
  977 |         const res = await sendInventoryCommand('updateContainerLocation', {
  978 |             containerId: resolveSpecialContainerId(containerId),
  979 |             location: locationData
  980 |         });
  981 |         return res.success;
  982 |     },
  983 | 
  984 |     getContainerWeight: function(containerId) {
  985 |         const cont = ContainerRegistry.get(containerId);
  986 |         if (!cont) return 0;
  987 |         return getContainerItems(cont).reduce((sum, itemId) => {
  988 |             const it = ItemRegistry.get(itemId);
  989 |             return sum + (it ? (it.custom_props.weight_per_unit ?? requireRuntimeNumber(getGameplayRuntimeConfig().inventory.default_item_weight, 'gameplay_runtime.inventory.default_item_weight')) * it.stack_size : 0);
  990 |         }, 0);
  991 |     },
  992 |     findItemByPrototype: function(containerId, protoId) {
  993 |         const cont = ContainerRegistry.get(containerId);
  994 |         if (!cont) return null;
  995 |         return getContainerItems(cont).find(id => {
  996 |             const it = ItemRegistry.get(id);
  997 |             return it && (it.prototype_id === protoId || it.custom_props?.aiIdentifier === protoId);
  998 |         });
  999 |     },
 1000 |     moveItem: async function(itemId, sourceContainerId, targetContainerId, quantity = null, options = {}) {
 1001 |         const actualTargetId = resolveSpecialContainerId(targetContainerId) || await getOrCreateGroundPileAsync(resolveContainerLocation(sourceContainerId) || resolveActorLocation(options.actorId || getInventoryActorId('default')));
 1002 |         const res = await sendInventoryCommand(getInventoryCommandName('move_item'), {
 1003 |             itemId, targetContainerId: actualTargetId, quantity: serializeInventoryMoveQuantity(quantity)
 1004 |         });
 1005 |         return { success: res.success, movedItemId: res.movedItemId, error: res.feedback };
 1006 |     },
 1007 |     moveItems: async function(sourceContainerId, targetContainerId, items, options = {}) {
 1008 |         const actualTargetId = resolveSpecialContainerId(targetContainerId) || await getOrCreateGroundPileAsync(resolveContainerLocation(sourceContainerId) || resolveActorLocation(options.actorId || getInventoryActorId('default')));
 1009 |         const res = await sendInventoryCommand(getInventoryCommandName('move_items'), {
 1010 |             sourceContainerId: resolveSpecialContainerId(sourceContainerId),
 1011 |             targetContainerId: actualTargetId,
 1012 |             items: items
 1013 |         });
 1014 |         return { success: res.success, error: res.feedback };
 1015 |     },
 1016 |     removeItem: async function(itemId, quantity) {
 1017 |         const item = ItemRegistry.get(itemId);
 1018 |         const shouldSyncGold = item && isGoldLikeItem(item) && item.container_id === player?.container_backpack;
 1019 |         const res = await sendInventoryCommand(getInventoryCommandName('remove_item'), { itemId, quantity });
 1020 |         if (shouldSyncGold) syncPlayerGoldFromInventory();
 1021 |         return res.success;
 1022 |     },
 1023 |     destroyContainer: async function(containerId) {
 1024 |         const resolvedContainerId = resolveSpecialContainerId(containerId);
 1025 |         const groundPileId = await getOrCreateGroundPileAsync(resolveContainerLocation(resolvedContainerId));
 1026 |         const res = await sendInventoryCommand(getInventoryCommandName('destroy_container'), {
 1027 |             containerId: resolvedContainerId, groundContainerId: groundPileId
 1028 |         });
 1029 |         return res.success;
 1030 |     },
 1031 |     unlockContainer: async function(containerId, actorId) {
 1032 |         const resolvedContainerId = resolveSpecialContainerId(containerId);
 1033 |         const cont = ContainerRegistry.get(resolvedContainerId);
 1034 |         if (!cont || !cont.lock_data.is_locked) return { success: false, error: "Not locked or not found" };
 1035 |         if (!OwnershipService.canAccess(actorId, resolvedContainerId, { allowLocked: true })) return { success: false, error: "Too far away from container" };
 1036 |         const actorContId = actorId === 'player' ? player.container_backpack : null;
 1037 |         if (!actorContId) return { success: false, error: "Actor inventory not found" };
 1038 |         const actorCont = ContainerRegistry.get(actorContId);
 1039 |         const lockpickId = getContainerItems(actorCont).find(id => ItemRegistry.get(id)?.prototype_id === 'lockpicks_common');
 1040 |         if (!lockpickId) return { success: false, error: "No lockpicks" };
 1041 |         await this.removeItem(lockpickId, 1);
 1042 |         const roll = GameRNG.d20((player.stats.dex - 10)/2);
 1043 |         if (roll >= cont.lock_data.difficulty) {
 1044 |             cont.lock_data.is_locked = false;
 1045 |             return { success: true, message: "Unlocked successfully" };
 1046 |         } else {
 1047 |             let trapMsg = "";
 1048 |             if (cont.lock_data.trap) {
 1049 |                 if (cont.lock_data.trap.stat === 'hp') damagePlayerHP(cont.lock_data.trap.amount);
 1050 |                 trapMsg = ` Сработала ловушка! Урон: ${cont.lock_data.trap.amount}.`;
 1051 |             }
 1052 |             return { success: false, error: "Lockpick broke, failed to unlock." + trapMsg };
 1053 |         }
 1054 |     },
 1055 |     confiscateStolen: async function(sourceContainerId, destContainerId) {
 1056 |         const resolvedSourceId = resolveSpecialContainerId(sourceContainerId);
 1057 |         let resolvedDestId = resolveSpecialContainerId(destContainerId);
 1058 |         if (!resolvedDestId && resolveSystemContainerKey(destContainerId) === 'guard_confiscation_chest') {
 1059 |             resolvedDestId = await ensureGuardConfiscationChest();
 1060 |         }
 1061 |         const src = ContainerRegistry.get(resolvedSourceId);
 1062 |         if (!src) return 0;
 1063 |         const stolenItems = getContainerItems(src).filter(id => ItemRegistry.get(id)?.flags?.stolen);
 1064 |         let count = 0;
 1065 |         for (const id of stolenItems) {
 1066 |             const res = await this.moveItem(id, resolvedSourceId, resolvedDestId, null, { actorId: getInventoryActorId('system'), ignoreAccess: true, ignoreDistance: true });
 1067 |             if (res.success) count++;
 1068 |         }
 1069 |         return count;
 1070 |     },
 1071 |     buildContainer: async function(actorId, type, location) {
 1072 |         const actorContId = actorId === 'player' ? player.container_backpack : null;
 1073 |         if (!actorContId) return null;
 1074 |         const actorCont = ContainerRegistry.get(actorContId);
 1075 |         const buildConfig = getInventoryBuildingRuntimeConfig();
 1076 |         const resourceId = getContainerItems(actorCont).find(id => ItemRegistry.get(id)?.prototype_id === buildConfig.resource_prototype_id);
 1077 |         const resourceItem = resourceId ? ItemRegistry.get(resourceId) : null;
 1078 |         if (!resourceItem || resourceItem.stack_size < buildConfig.resource_cost) return null;
 1079 |         await this.removeItem(resourceId, buildConfig.resource_cost);
 1080 |         return await this.createContainer(type, actorId, buildConfig.default_max_weight_kg, buildConfig.default_max_slots, buildConstructedContainerLocation(location, buildConfig));
 1081 |     }

 1083 | // DEPRECATED: CoreInventorySystem alias removed.
 1084 | // Previously, this was: const CoreInventorySystem = CoreInventorySystemAsync;
 1085 | // This was DANGEROUS because callers used sync patterns (no await) on async functions,
 1086 | // causing silent failures (promises not awaited, operations silently dropped).
 1087 | // 
 1088 | // MIGRATION GUIDE:
 1089 | // - For code that NEEDS sync behavior (UI helpers, pure local calculations):
 1090 | //   Use OldCoreInventorySystem directly — it operates on local registries only.
 1091 | // - For code that NEEDS engine synchronization (persisting to C++ engine):
 1092 | //   Use CoreInventorySystemAsync and ALWAYS await the result.
 1093 | // - NEVER call CoreInventorySystemAsync methods without await.
 1094 | // - If you see "CoreInventorySystem" in code, replace it with either
 1095 | //   OldCoreInventorySystem (sync, local) or CoreInventorySystemAsync (async, networked).
 1096 | //
 1097 | // FIX (Issue #85/#38): OldCoreInventorySystem is now explicitly marked as @deprecated.
 1098 | // It will be removed in a future version once all callers migrate to CoreInventorySystemAsync.
 1099 | // The Proxy wrapper below (CoreInventorySystem) is the transition layer.
 1100 | 
 1101 | /**
 1102 |  * @deprecated Use CoreInventorySystemAsync (async, networked) instead.
 1103 |  * OldCoreInventorySystem is the sync, local-only implementation.
 1104 |  * It operates on local JS registries only and does NOT sync with the C++ engine.
 1105 |  * Kept for backward compatibility — will be removed in a future version.
 1106 |  */
 1107 | 
 1108 | // Backward compatibility wrapper that warns when used without proper async handling
 1109 | const CoreInventorySystem = new Proxy(OldCoreInventorySystem, {
 1110 |     get(target, prop) {
 1111 |         if (prop in CoreInventorySystemAsync && typeof CoreInventorySystemAsync[prop] === 'function') {
 1112 |             // Return the async version but log a deprecation warning
 1113 |             const asyncFn = CoreInventorySystemAsync[prop];
 1114 |             return function(...args) {
 1115 |                 const stackHint = new Error().stack?.split('\n')[2]?.trim() || 'unknown caller';
 1116 |                 console.warn(`[DEPRECATED] CoreInventorySystem.${prop}() called — this returns a Promise. Use "await CoreInventorySystemAsync.${prop}()" instead. Called from: ${stackHint}`);
 1117 |                 const result = asyncFn.apply(this, args);
 1118 |                 // If the result is a promise, check if it's being awaited
 1119 |                 if (result && typeof result.then === 'function') {
 1120 |                     result.catch(err => {
 1121 |                         console.error(`[CoreInventorySystem] Unhandled async error in ${prop}():`, err);
 1122 |                     });
 1123 |                 }
 1124 |                 return result;
 1125 |             };
 1126 |         }
 1127 |         return target[prop];
 1128 |     }
