 1131 | async function equipItemAsync(itemId, targetSlot = null) {
 1132 |     if (window.ModAPI) ModAPI.emit('onPlayerEquipped', {itemId, slot: targetSlot, action: 'equip'});
 1133 |     if (!player || !player.container_backpack || !player.container_equipment) return null;
 1134 |     const itemToEquip = ItemRegistry.get(itemId);
 1135 |     if (!itemToEquip || itemToEquip.container_id !== player.container_backpack) return null;
 1136 | 
 1137 |     if (!targetSlot) {
 1138 |         const allPossibleSlots = bodySlots.filter(s => !itemToEquip.custom_props.slot || itemToEquip.custom_props.slot === s || (['right_hand', 'left_hand'].includes(s) && ['right_hand', 'left_hand'].includes(itemToEquip.custom_props.slot)));
 1139 |         if (allPossibleSlots.length === 0) return t('gameInterface.commandFeedback.itemNotEquipable', { itemName: itemToEquip.custom_props.name });
 1140 |         const eqCont = ContainerRegistry.get(player.container_equipment);
 1141 |         targetSlot = allPossibleSlots.find(s => !getContainerItems(eqCont).find(id => ItemRegistry.get(id).slot_index === s));
 1142 |         if (!targetSlot) targetSlot = allPossibleSlots[0];
 1143 |     }
 1144 | 
 1145 |     if (!bodySlots.includes(targetSlot)) return `[ERROR] Попытка экипировать в несуществующий слот: '${targetSlot}'`;
 1146 | 
 1147 |     const res = await sendInventoryCommand(getInventoryCommandName('equip_item'), {
 1148 |         itemId, slot: targetSlot, equipmentContainerId: player.container_equipment, backpackContainerId: player.container_backpack
 1149 |     });
 1150 | 
 1151 |     if (res.success) {
 1152 |         updateInventoryDisplay();
 1153 |         updateEquipmentDisplay();
 1154 |         updateCharacterSheet();
 1155 |         queuePlayerActionForGM(`Player equipped item '${itemToEquip.custom_props.name}' to slot '${targetSlot}'.`);
 1156 |         if (itemTooltipElement) itemTooltipElement.style.display = 'none';
 1157 |         return t('gameInterface.commandFeedback.itemEquipped', { itemName: itemToEquip.custom_props.name, slot: targetSlot });
 1158 |     }
 1159 |     return res.feedback;
 1160 | }

 1162 | async function unequipItemAsync(slot) {
 1163 |     if (!player || !player.container_equipment || !player.container_backpack) return null;
 1164 |     const eqCont = ContainerRegistry.get(player.container_equipment);
 1165 |     const itemId = getContainerItems(eqCont).find(id => ItemRegistry.get(id).slot_index === slot);
 1166 |     if (!itemId) return t('gameInterface.commandFeedback.slotIsEmpty', { slot: slot });
 1167 | 
 1168 |     const itemToUnequip = ItemRegistry.get(itemId);
 1169 |     const backpack = ContainerRegistry.get(player.container_backpack);
 1170 |

 1172 |         return t('gameInterface.commandFeedback.inventoryFullOnUnequip', { itemName: itemToUnequip.custom_props.name });
 1173 |     }
 1174 |

 1176 |         slot, equipmentContainerId: player.container_equipment, backpackContainerId: player.container_backpack
 1177 |     });
 1178 |

 1180 |         updateInventoryDisplay();
 1181 |         updateEquipmentDisplay();

 1185 |         return t('gameInterface.commandFeedback.itemUnequipped', { itemName: itemToUnequip.custom_props.name, slot: slot });
 1186 |     }

 1288 | // Delegated event listener for data-action buttons (CSP-compliant replacement for inline onclick)
 1289 | document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
 1290 |     const action = e.target.closest('[data-action]');
 1291 |     if (!action) return;
 1292 |     const act = action.getAttribute('data-action');
 1293 |     if (act === 'cancel-api' && typeof window.cancelCurrentApiRequest === 'function') {
 1294 |         window.cancelCurrentApiRequest();
 1295 |     } else if (act === 'dismount-transport') {
 1296 |         dismountTransport().catch(e => console.error('[dismountTransport]', e));
 1297 |     } else if (act === 'admin-add-gold') {
 1298 |         adminAddGold();
 1299 |     } else if (act === 'admin-heal') {
 1300 |         adminHeal();
 1301 |     } else if (act === 'admin-force-summary') {
 1302 |         adminForceSummary();
 1303 |     } else if (act === 'toggle-autotester') {
 1304 |         toggleAutoTester();
 1305 |     } else if (act === 'toggle-localization') {
 1306 |         window.DISABLE_LOCALIZATION = !window.DISABLE_LOCALIZATION;
 1307 |         populateAdminMenu();
 1308 |     }

 1315 | async function mountTransport(itemId) {
 1316 |     if (!player || !player.container_backpack) return null;
 1317 | 
 1318 |     const item = ItemRegistry.get(itemId);
 1319 |     if (!item) return "Item not found";
 1320 | 
 1321 |     const transportTypes = TransportSystem.registry ? Object.keys(TransportSystem.registry) : ['horse', 'warhorse', 'cart', 'wagon', 'ship_deed'];
 1322 |     const isTransportByPrototype = transportTypes.includes(item.prototype_id);
 1323 |     const isTransportByProperty = item.custom_props?.isTransport === true;
 1324 | 
 1325 |     if (!isTransportByPrototype && !isTransportByProperty) {
 1326 |         return t('transport.notTransport', 'This item is not a transport');
 1327 |     }
 1328 | 
 1329 |     const feedback = await executeCommand('mountTransport', {
 1330 |         itemId: itemId,
 1331 |         backpackContainerId: player.container_backpack
 1332 |     });
 1333 | 
 1334 |     if (feedback && !feedback.includes('ERROR')) {
 1335 |         await updateTransportUI();
 1336 |         addLogMessage(feedback, 'system-message');
 1337 |         queuePlayerActionForGM(`Player mounted transport: ${item.custom_props.name || item.prototype_id}`);
 1338 |     }
 1339 | 
 1340 |     return feedback || "Failed to mount transport";
 1341 | }
 1342 | 
 1343 | async function dismountTransport() {
 1344 |     const feedback = await executeCommand('dismountTransport', {});
 1345 | 
 1346 |     if (feedback && !feedback.includes('ERROR')) {
 1347 |         await updateTransportUI();
 1348 |         addLogMessage(feedback, 'system-message');
 1349 |         queuePlayerActionForGM('Player dismounted transport');
 1350 |     }
 1351 | 
 1352 |     return feedback || "Failed to dismount transport";
 1353 | }

 1405 | const TradeSystemAsync = {
 1406 |     activeTrades: new Map(),
 1407 |     _toggleConfirmButton: function(tradeId = null) {
 1408 |         const btn = document.getElementById('trade-confirm-btn');
 1409 |         if (!btn) return;
 1410 |         if (!tradeId) {
 1411 |             btn.style.display = 'none';
 1412 |             btn.onclick = null;
 1413 |             return;
 1414 |         }
 1415 |         btn.style.display = 'inline-block';
 1416 |         btn.onclick = async () => {
 1417 |             const res = await this.confirmTrade(tradeId);
 1418 |             addLogMessage(res.success ? "[ТОРГОВЛЯ] Сделка подтверждена игроком и успешно завершена." : `[ERROR] Ошибка сделки: ${res.error}`, "system-message");
 1419 |             if (res.success || res.error) {
 1420 |                 player.active_trade_id = null;
 1421 |                 updateInventoryDisplay();
 1422 |                 updateEquipmentDisplay();
 1423 |                 updateCharacterSheet();
 1424 |             }
 1425 |         };
 1426 |     },
 1427 |     _normalizeTradeItems: function(items) { return OldTradeSystem._normalizeTradeItems(items); },
 1428 |     _lockItemForTrade: function(itemId) { return OldTradeSystem._lockItemForTrade(itemId); },
 1429 |     _releaseTradeLocks: function(trade) { return OldTradeSystem._releaseTradeLocks(trade); },
 1430 |     _snapshotTradeState: function(trade) { return OldTradeSystem._snapshotTradeState(trade); },
 1431 |     _restoreTradeSnapshot: function(snapshot, createdItemIds = []) { return OldTradeSystem._restoreTradeSnapshot(snapshot, createdItemIds); },
 1432 |     _validateTradeDistance: function(trade) { return OldTradeSystem._validateTradeDistance(trade); },
 1433 |     _prepareMerchantSale: function(trade, offerItems) { return OldTradeSystem._prepareMerchantSale(trade, offerItems); },
 1434 |     _prepareManualTrade: function(trade, offerItems, requestItems) { return OldTradeSystem._prepareManualTrade(trade, offerItems, requestItems); },
 1435 |     initiateTrade: async function(config) {
 1436 |         return OldTradeSystem.initiateTrade.call(this, config);
 1437 |     },
 1438 |     addItemToTrade: async function(tradeId, itemId, side, quantity) {
 1439 |         return OldTradeSystem.addItemToTrade.call(this, tradeId, itemId, side, quantity);
 1440 |     },
 1441 |     _validateTradeReady: function(trade) { return OldTradeSystem._validateTradeReady(trade); },
 1442 |     _executeItemTransfers: async function(items, sourceContainerId, targetContainerId, createdItemIds) {
 1443 |         for (const entry of items) {
 1444 |             const res = await CoreInventorySystemAsync.moveItem(entry.id, sourceContainerId, targetContainerId, entry.quantity, {
 1445 |                 actorId: getInventoryActorId('system'), ignoreAccess: true, ignoreDistance: true, allowTradeLocked: true, allowLocked: true
 1446 |             });
 1447 |             if (!res.success) return res;
 1448 |             if (res.createdItemId) createdItemIds.push(res.createdItemId);
 1449 |             if (ItemRegistry.has(entry.id)) ItemRegistry.get(entry.id).state = 'idle';
 1450 |             if (ItemRegistry.has(res.movedItemId)) ItemRegistry.get(res.movedItemId).state = 'idle';
 1451 |         }
 1452 |         return { success: true };
 1453 |     },
 1454 |     _transferMerchantGold: async function(trade, createdItemIds) {
 1455 |         let remaining = trade.final_price;
 1456 |         const targetContainer = ContainerRegistry.get(trade.target_container);
 1457 |         if (!targetContainer) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('merchant_container_not_found', 'Merchant container not found') };
 1458 | 
 1459 |         const physicalGoldItems = [...getContainerItems(targetContainer)].filter(itemId => {
 1460 |             const it = ItemRegistry.get(itemId);
 1461 |             return it && isGoldLikeItem(it);
 1462 |         });
 1463 |         for (const goldItemId of physicalGoldItems) {
 1464 |             if (remaining <= 0) break;
 1465 |             const goldItem = ItemRegistry.get(goldItemId);
 1466 |             const amountToMove = Math.min(goldItem.stack_size, remaining);
 1467 |             const res = await CoreInventorySystemAsync.moveItem(goldItemId, trade.target_container, trade.initiator_container, amountToMove, {
 1468 |                 actorId: getInventoryActorId('system'), ignoreAccess: true, ignoreDistance: true, allowLocked: true
 1469 |             });
 1470 |             if (!res.success) return res;
 1471 |             if (res.createdItemId) createdItemIds.push(res.createdItemId);
 1472 |             remaining -= amountToMove;
 1473 |         }
 1474 | 
 1475 |         if (remaining > 0) {
 1476 |             const merchant = World?.npcs?.[trade.target];
 1477 |             if (!merchant?.inventory || merchant.inventory.gold < remaining) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('merchant_account_short_gold', 'Merchant account is short on gold') };
 1478 |             const buyerContainer = ContainerRegistry.get(trade.initiator_container);
 1479 |             const primaryCurrencyId = getPrimaryCurrencyPrototypeId('gold');
 1480 |             const existingGoldId = CoreInventorySystemAsync.findItemByPrototype(trade.initiator_container, primaryCurrencyId);
 1481 |             const currentWeight = CoreInventorySystemAsync.getContainerWeight(trade.initiator_container);
 1482 |             const addedWeight = remaining * getCurrencyPhysicalWeight(primaryCurrencyId, 0.01);
 1483 |             if (!existingGoldId && getContainerItems(buyerContainer).length >= buyerContainer.max_slots) {
 1484 |                 return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('buyer_no_gold_slot', 'Buyer container has no free slot for gold') };
 1485 |             }
 1486 |             if (currentWeight + addedWeight > buyerContainer.max_weight_kg) {
 1487 |                 return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('buyer_cannot_carry_gold', 'Buyer container cannot carry the gold payment') };
 1488 |             }
 1489 | 
 1490 |             merchant.inventory.gold -= remaining;
 1491 |             const createdGoldId = await CoreInventorySystemAsync.createItem(primaryCurrencyId, remaining, trade.initiator_container, { name: getItemName(primaryCurrencyId, player?.era) });
 1492 |             createdItemIds.push(createdGoldId);
 1493 |             remaining = 0;
 1494 |         }
 1495 | 
 1496 |         syncPlayerGoldFromInventory();
 1497 |         return { success: true };
 1498 |     },
 1499 |     _postProcessTrade: function(trade) { return TradeSystem._postProcessTrade(trade); },
 1500 |     confirmTrade: async function(tradeId) {
 1501 |         if (!this.activeTrades.has(tradeId)) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('trade_not_found', 'Trade not found') };
 1502 |         const trade = this.activeTrades.get(tradeId);
 1503 | 
 1504 |         const readiness = this._validateTradeReady(trade);
 1505 |         if (!readiness.success) return this._rollbackTrade(tradeId, readiness.error);
 1506 | 
 1507 |         const snapshot = this._snapshotTradeState(trade);
 1508 |         const createdItemIds = [];
 1509 | 
 1510 |         const offerResult = await this._executeItemTransfers(trade.offer_items, trade.initiator_container, trade.target_container, createdItemIds);
 1511 |         if (!offerResult.success) {
 1512 |             this._restoreTradeSnapshot(snapshot, createdItemIds);
 1513 |             return this._rollbackTrade(tradeId, offerResult.error || "Failed to move offer item");
 1514 |         }
 1515 | 
 1516 |         let requestResult = { success: true };
 1517 |         if (trade.mode === 'manual') {
 1518 |             requestResult = await this._executeItemTransfers(trade.request_items, trade.target_container, trade.initiator_container, createdItemIds);
 1519 |         } else {
 1520 |             requestResult = await this._transferMerchantGold(trade, createdItemIds);
 1521 |         }
 1522 | 
 1523 |         if (!requestResult.success) {
 1524 |             this._restoreTradeSnapshot(snapshot, createdItemIds);
 1525 |             return this._rollbackTrade(tradeId, requestResult.error || "Failed to complete trade payment");
 1526 |         }
 1527 | 
 1528 |         trade.status = "completed";
 1529 |         this.activeTrades.delete(tradeId);
 1530 |         this._toggleConfirmButton(null);
 1531 |         if (player?.active_trade_id === tradeId) player.active_trade_id = null;
 1532 |         syncPlayerGoldFromInventory();
 1533 |         this._postProcessTrade(trade);
 1534 |         return { success: true, tradeId, price: trade.final_price || 0 };
 1535 |     },
 1536 |     _rollbackTrade: function(tradeId, reason) { return OldTradeSystem._rollbackTrade.call(this, tradeId, reason); },
 1537 |     negotiateTrade: async function(tradeId, newOffer, newRequestItems = []) {
 1538 |         return OldTradeSystem.negotiateTrade.call(this, tradeId, newOffer, newRequestItems);
 1539 |     }
 1540 | };

 1542 | async function executeCommand(command, args) {
 1543 |     if (window.ModAPI) ModAPI.emit('onCommandExecuted', {command, args});
 1544 |     if (!command) return null;
 1545 |     if (!player) return t('gameInterface.commandFeedback.errorPlayerMissing');
 1546 | 
 1547 |     // Shallow-clone args to prevent mutation of the caller's object
 1548 |     if (args && typeof args === 'object') {
 1549 |         args = { ...args };
 1550 |         if (args.entityKey !== undefined && args.aiIdentifier === undefined) args.aiIdentifier = args.entityKey;
 1551 |         if (args.target !== undefined && args.aiIdentifier === undefined && args.target !== 'player') args.aiIdentifier = args.target;
 1552 |         if (args.id !== undefined) {
 1553 |             if (args.aiIdentifier === undefined) args.aiIdentifier = args.id;
 1554 |             if (args.key === undefined) args.key = args.id;
 1555 |             if (args.effectId === undefined) args.effectId = args.id;
 1556 |         }
 1557 |         if (args.id === undefined) args.id = args.aiIdentifier || args.key || args.effectId;
 1558 |         if (command.toLowerCase().includes('quest') && args.id === undefined && args.title !== undefined) {
 1559 |             args.id = args.title;
 1560 |             args.aiIdentifier = args.title;
 1561 |         }
 1562 |     }
 1563 | 
 1564 |     console.log("Выполнение команды (ASYNC):", command, args);
 1565 |     let feedback = null;
 1566 | 
 1567 |     // Гарантируем, что рюкзак и экипировка существуют перед выполнением команд
 1568 |     const inventoryCommands = ['addItem', 'removeItem', 'equipItem', 'unequipItem', 'moveItem', 'updateStat', 'createContainer', 'destroyContainer', 'useItem', 'openContainer', 'trade', 'sell'];
 1569 |     if (inventoryCommands.includes(command)) {
 1570 |         await ensurePlayerContainers();
 1571 |     }
 1572 | 
 1573 |     try {
 1574 |         // --- ИНТЕГРАЦИЯ МОДОВ: Кастомные команды ---
 1575 |         if (window.ModAPI && window.ModAPI.customCommands && window.ModAPI.customCommands[command]) {
 1576 |             return await window.ModAPI.customCommands[command](args);
 1577 |         }
 1578 |         // -------------------------------------------
 1579 | 
 1580 |         switch (command) {
 1581 |             case 'echoMemory':
 1582 |             case 'clearEchoMemory':
 1583 |             case 'removeEchoMemoryItem':
 1584 |             case 'setMemory':
 1585 |             case 'deleteMemory':
 1586 |             case 'archiveMemory':
 1587 |             case 'setLocation':
 1588 |             case 'gmDeclareWar':

 1596 |             case 'startTravel':
 1597 |             case 'pauseTravel':
 1598 |             case 'resumeTravel':
 1599 |             case 'cancelTravel':
 1600 |             case 'fastForwardTravel':
 1601 |             case 'startJourney':
 1602 |             case 'endJourney':
 1603 |             case 'setJourneyLocation':
 1604 |             case 'calculationLog':
 1605 |             case 'defineFaction':
 1606 |             case 'updateStat':
 1607 |             case 'setStat':
 1608 |             case 'addQuest':
 1609 |         if (window.ModAPI) ModAPI.emit('onQuestUpdated', {action: 'add', quest: args});
 1610 |             case 'updateQuest':
 1611 |             case 'removeQuest':
 1612 |             case 'editQuest':
 1613 |             case 'addSkill':
 1614 |             case 'removeSkill':
 1615 |             case 'addDiscoveredLocation':
 1616 |             case 'addMapMarker':
 1617 |             case 'removeMapMarker':
 1618 |             case 'addSubLocation':
 1619 |             case 'removeSubLocation':
 1620 |             case 'buildBusiness':
 1621 |             case 'buyHolding':
 1622 |             case 'sellHolding':
 1623 |             case 'bankTransaction':
 1624 |             case 'nexusDefine':
 1625 |             case 'nexusUpdate':
 1626 |             case 'nexusRemove':
 1627 |             case 'repairFacility':
 1628 |             case 'applyPredefinedEffect':
 1629 |             case 'addStatusEffect':
 1630 |             case 'removeStatusEffect':
 1631 |             case 'addEnvironment':
 1632 |             case 'removeEnvironment':

 1634 |             case 'setEntityState':

 1636 |             case 'setCombatState':
 1637 |             case 'endCombat':
 1638 |             case 'buildShip':
 1639 |             case 'buildPort':

 1641 |             case 'navalBlockade':

 1658 |

 1708 |                                 itemType: args.itemType || (isTransport ? 'vehicle' : 'misc'),
 1709 |                                 slot: args.slot || null,
 1710 |                                 effects: args.effects || [],

 1713 |                                 isTransport: isTransport,

 1720 |                                 const validIds = TransportSystem.getAllTransportIds();

 1722 |                                 await CoreInventorySystemAsync.createItem(aiId, quantity, targetContId, customProps);
 1723 |                                 feedback = t('gameInterface.commandFeedback.itemAdded', { itemName: name, quantity: quantity }) + ` [WARNING] ID "${aiId}" не является транспортом. Используйте: ${validIds.join(', ')}`;
 1724 |                             } else {
 1725 |                                 await CoreInventorySystemAsync.createItem(aiId, quantity, targetContId, customProps);
 1726 |                                 feedback = t('gameInterface.commandFeedback.itemAdded', { itemName: name, quantity: quantity });
 1727 |                             }

 1739 |                 }

 1741 | 
 1742 |                                     case 'removeItem': {

 1754 |

 1756 |                     foundKey = getContainerItems(backpack).find(id => {
 1757 |                         const it = ItemRegistry.get(id);

 1759 |                     });

 1766 |                     });

 2204 |     _normalizeTradeItems: function(items) {
 2205 |         return (items || []).map(entry => ({
 2206 |             id: entry.id,
 2207 |             quantity: parseInt(entry.quantity, 10) || requireRuntimeNumber(getGameplayRuntimeConfig().inventory.default_stack_quantity, 'gameplay_runtime.inventory.default_stack_quantity')
 2208 |         })).filter(entry => entry.id && entry.quantity > 0);
 2209 |     },
 2210 |     _lockItemForTrade: function(itemId) {
 2211 |         const item = ItemRegistry.get(itemId);
 2212 |         if (!item || item.state !== 'idle') return false;
 2213 |         item.state = 'in_trade';
 2214 |         return true;
 2215 |     },
 2216 |     _releaseTradeLocks: function(trade) {
 2217 |         [...(trade.offer_items || []), ...(trade.request_items || [])].forEach(entry => {
 2218 |             if (ItemRegistry.has(entry.id)) ItemRegistry.get(entry.id).state = 'idle';
 2219 |         });
 2220 |     },
 2221 |     _snapshotTradeState: function(trade) {
 2222 |         const containerIds = new Set([trade.initiator_container, trade.target_container].filter(Boolean));
 2223 |         const itemIds = new Set();
 2224 |         [...(trade.offer_items || []), ...(trade.request_items || [])].forEach(entry => itemIds.add(entry.id));
 2225 |         containerIds.forEach(containerId => {
 2226 |             const cont = ContainerRegistry.get(containerId);
 2227 |             if (cont) {
 2228 |                 getContainerItems(cont).forEach(itemId => {
 2229 |                     const it = ItemRegistry.get(itemId);
 2230 |                     if (it && isGoldLikeItem(it)) itemIds.add(itemId);

 2235 |             containers: Array.from(containerIds).map(containerId => [containerId, structuredClone(ContainerRegistry.get(containerId))]),
 2236 |             items: Array.from(itemIds).filter(itemId => ItemRegistry.has(itemId)).map(itemId => [itemId, structuredClone(ItemRegistry.get(itemId))]),
 2237 |             npcGoldState: trade.target && World?.npcs?.[trade.target]?.inventory ? { npcId: trade.target, gold: World.npcs[trade.target].inventory.gold || 0 } : null,
 2238 |             playerGold: player?.stats?.gold ?? null
 2239 |         };
 2240 |     },
 2241 |     _restoreTradeSnapshot: function(snapshot, createdItemIds = []) {
 2242 |         if (!snapshot) return;
 2243 |         snapshot.containers.forEach(([containerId, data]) => {
 2244 |             if (data) setContainer(containerId, structuredClone(data));
 2245 |         });
 2246 |         const snapshotItemIds = new Set(snapshot.items.map(([itemId]) => itemId));
 2247 |         createdItemIds.forEach(itemId => {
 2248 |             if (!snapshotItemIds.has(itemId)) ItemRegistry.delete(itemId);
 2249 |         });
 2250 |         snapshot.items.forEach(([itemId, data]) => {
 2251 |             if (data) ItemRegistry.set(itemId, structuredClone(data));
 2252 |         });
 2253 |         if (snapshot.npcGoldState && World?.npcs?.[snapshot.npcGoldState.npcId]?.inventory) {

 2265 |     _prepareMerchantSale: function(trade, offerItems) {

 2297 |         trade.final_price = totalPrice;

 2300 |             max_price: Math.max(totalPrice, Math.ceil(totalPrice * 1.15))
 2301 |         };

 2389 |     addItemToTrade: function(tradeId, itemId, side, quantity) {
 2390 |         if (!this.activeTrades.has(tradeId)) return false;

 2394 |         if (item.stack_size < quantity) return false;

 2405 |     _validateTradeReady: function(trade) {
 2406 |         if (!this._validateTradeDistance(trade)) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('trade_too_far', 'Trade parties are too far apart') };
 2407 | 
 2408 |         for (const offer of trade.offer_items) {
 2409 |             const item = ItemRegistry.get(offer.id);
 2410 |             if (!item || item.container_id !== trade.initiator_container) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('offer_moved_before_confirmation', 'Offer item moved before confirmation') };
 2411 |             if (item.stack_size < offer.quantity) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('offer_quantity_changed', 'Offer quantity changed before confirmation') };
 2412 |             if (item.state !== getInventoryMovementRuntimeConfig().states.trade_locked) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('offer_no_longer_locked', 'Offer item is no longer locked for trade') };
 2413 |         }
 2414 | 
 2415 |         for (const request of trade.request_items) {
 2416 |             const item = ItemRegistry.get(request.id);
 2417 |             if (!item || item.container_id !== trade.target_container) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('request_moved_before_confirmation', 'Request item moved before confirmation') };
 2418 |             if (item.stack_size < request.quantity) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('request_quantity_changed', 'Request quantity changed before confirmation') };
 2419 |             if (item.state !== getInventoryMovementRuntimeConfig().states.trade_locked) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('request_no_longer_locked', 'Request item is no longer locked for trade') };
 2420 |         }
 2421 | 
 2422 |         if (trade.mode === 'sale' && getGoldAmountInContainer(trade.target_container) < trade.final_price) {
 2423 |             return { success: false, error: "Merchant no longer has enough gold" };
 2424 |         }
 2425 | 
 2426 |         return { success: true };
 2427 |     },
 2428 |     _executeItemTransfers: async function(items, sourceContainerId, targetContainerId, createdItemIds) {

 2431 |                 ...getInventoryTransferOptions('system_full_access')
 2432 |             });

 2434 |             if (res.createdItemId) createdItemIds.push(res.createdItemId);
 2435 |             if (ItemRegistry.has(entry.id)) ItemRegistry.get(entry.id).state = 'idle';
 2436 |             if (ItemRegistry.has(res.movedItemId)) ItemRegistry.get(res.movedItemId).state = 'idle';
 2437 |         }
 2438 |         return { success: true };
 2439 |     },
 2440 |     _transferMerchantGold: async function(trade, createdItemIds) {
 2441 |         let remaining = trade.final_price;
 2442 |         const targetContainer = ContainerRegistry.get(trade.target_container);
 2443 |         if (!targetContainer) return { success: false, error: "Merchant container not found" };
 2444 | 
 2445 |         const physicalGoldItems = [...getContainerItems(targetContainer)].filter(itemId => {
 2446 |             const it = ItemRegistry.get(itemId);
 2447 |             return it && isGoldLikeItem(it);
 2448 |         });
 2449 |         for (const goldItemId of physicalGoldItems) {
 2450 |             if (remaining <= 0) break;
 2451 |             const goldItem = ItemRegistry.get(goldItemId);
 2452 |             const amountToMove = Math.min(goldItem.stack_size, remaining);
 2453 |             const res = await CoreInventorySystemAsync.moveItem(goldItemId, trade.target_container, trade.initiator_container, amountToMove, {
 2454 |                 ...getInventoryTransferOptions('system_ignore_access'),
 2455 |                 allowLocked: true
 2456 |             });
 2457 |             if (!res.success) return res;
 2458 |             if (res.createdItemId) createdItemIds.push(res.createdItemId);
 2459 |             remaining -= amountToMove;
 2460 |         }
 2461 | 
 2462 |         if (remaining > 0) {
 2463 |             const merchant = World?.npcs?.[trade.target];
 2464 |             if (!merchant?.inventory || merchant.inventory.gold < remaining) return { success: false, error: "Merchant account is short on gold" };
 2465 |             const buyerContainer = ContainerRegistry.get(trade.initiator_container);
 2466 |             const existingGoldId = CoreInventorySystemAsync.findItemByPrototype(trade.initiator_container, 'gold');
 2467 |             const currentWeight = CoreInventorySystemAsync.getContainerWeight(trade.initiator_container);
 2468 |             const addedWeight = remaining * 0.01;
 2469 |             if (!existingGoldId && getContainerItems(buyerContainer).length >= buyerContainer.max_slots) {
 2470 |                 return { success: false, error: "Buyer container has no free slot for gold" };
 2471 |             }
 2472 |             if (currentWeight + addedWeight > buyerContainer.max_weight_kg) {
 2473 |                 return { success: false, error: "Buyer container cannot carry the gold payment" };
 2474 |             }
 2475 | 
 2476 |             merchant.inventory.gold -= remaining;
 2477 |             if (existingGoldId) {
 2478 |                 ItemRegistry.get(existingGoldId).stack_size += remaining;
 2479 |             } else {
 2480 |                 const createdGoldId = await CoreInventorySystemAsync.createItem('gold', remaining, trade.initiator_container, { name: getItemName('gold', player?.era) });
 2481 |                 createdItemIds.push(createdGoldId);
 2482 |             }
 2483 |             remaining = 0;
 2484 |         }
 2485 | 
 2486 |         syncPlayerGoldFromInventory();
 2487 |         return { success: true };
 2488 |     },
 2489 |     _postProcessTrade: async function(trade) {
 2490 |         if (trade.target !== 'player' && typeof World !== 'undefined' && World && World.npcs?.[trade.target]) {
 2491 |             const npc = World.npcs[trade.target];
 2492 |             const regionId = npc.currentLocation || npc.homeLocation || resolveContainerLocation(trade.target_container)?.region_id;
 2493 |             if (regionId && World.regions?.[regionId]) {
 2494 |                 const region = World.regions[regionId];

 2497 | 
 2498 |                 if (tradeValueGold > 0) {
 2499 |                     const tax = Math.max(1, Math.floor(tradeValueGold * 0.05));
 2500 |                     region.moneySupply += tax;

 2502 |                     if (factionId && region.vault_id) {
 2503 |                         await addRealItems(region.vault_id, 'gold', tax);
 2504 |                     }
 2505 |                 }
 2506 | 
 2507 |                 if (factionId && trade.initiator === 'player') {
 2508 |                     player.stats.reputation[factionId] = (player.stats.reputation[factionId] || 0) + 1;
 2509 |                 }
 2510 |             }
 2511 |         }
 2512 | 
 2513 |         if (World?.news) {
 2514 |             World.news.push({
 2515 |                 category: 'trade',
 2516 |                 text: `Игрок успешно завершил сделку с ${trade.target} на сумму ${trade.final_price || 0} золота.`,
 2517 |                 day: (World.current_day !== undefined ? World.current_day : Math.floor((World.tick || 0) / 24)),
 2518 |                 location: trade.region_id || "global",
 2519 |                 importance: 1
 2520 |             });
 2521 |         }
 2522 |         if (player?.worldEvents) {
 2523 |             player.worldEvents.push({
 2524 |                 type: 'trade_completed',
 2525 |                 turn: player.stats.turnCount,
 2526 |                 tradeId: trade.id,
 2527 |                 target: trade.target,
 2528 |                 price: trade.final_price || 0
 2529 |             });
 2530 |         }
 2531 |     },
 2532 |     confirmTrade: async function(tradeId) {
 2533 |         if (!this.activeTrades.has(tradeId)) return { success: false, error: "Trade not found" };
 2534 |         const trade = this.activeTrades.get(tradeId);
 2535 | 
 2536 |         const readiness = this._validateTradeReady(trade);
 2537 |         if (!readiness.success) return this._rollbackTrade(tradeId, readiness.error);
 2538 | 
 2539 |         const snapshot = this._snapshotTradeState(trade);
 2540 |         const createdItemIds = [];
 2541 | 
 2542 |         const offerResult = await this._executeItemTransfers(trade.offer_items, trade.initiator_container, trade.target_container, createdItemIds);
 2543 |         if (!offerResult.success) {
 2544 |             this._restoreTradeSnapshot(snapshot, createdItemIds);
 2545 |             return this._rollbackTrade(tradeId, offerResult.error || "Failed to move offer item");
 2546 |         }
 2547 | 
 2548 |         let requestResult = { success: true };
 2549 |         if (trade.mode === 'manual') {
 2550 |             requestResult = await this._executeItemTransfers(trade.request_items, trade.target_container, trade.initiator_container, createdItemIds);
 2551 |         } else {
 2552 |             requestResult = await this._transferMerchantGold(trade, createdItemIds);
 2553 |         }
 2554 | 
 2555 |         if (!requestResult.success) {
 2556 |             this._restoreTradeSnapshot(snapshot, createdItemIds);
 2557 |             return this._rollbackTrade(tradeId, requestResult.error || "Failed to complete trade payment");
 2558 |         }
 2559 | 
 2560 |         trade.status = "completed";
 2561 |         this.activeTrades.delete(tradeId);
 2562 |         this._toggleConfirmButton(null);
 2563 |         if (player?.active_trade_id === tradeId) player.active_trade_id = null;
 2564 |         syncPlayerGoldFromInventory();
 2565 |         await this._postProcessTrade(trade);
 2566 |         return { success: true, tradeId, price: trade.final_price || 0 };
 2567 |     },
 2568 |     _rollbackTrade: function(tradeId, reason) {
 2569 |         const trade = this.activeTrades.get(tradeId);
 2570 |         if (trade) {
 2571 |             this._releaseTradeLocks(trade);
 2572 |             trade.status = "failed";
 2573 |             this.activeTrades.delete(tradeId);
 2574 |         }
 2575 |         this._toggleConfirmButton(null);
 2576 |         if (player?.active_trade_id === tradeId) player.active_trade_id = null;
 2577 |         return { success: false, error: reason };
 2578 |     },
 2579 |     negotiateTrade: function(tradeId, newOffer, newRequestItems = []) {
 2580 |         if (!this.activeTrades.has(tradeId)) return { success: false, error: "Trade not found" };
 2581 |         const trade = this.activeTrades.get(tradeId);
 2582 |         if (trade.mode === 'sale') {
 2583 |             const requestedPrice = parseInt(newOffer, 10);
 2584 |             if (!Number.isFinite(requestedPrice) || requestedPrice <= 0) return { success: false, error: "Invalid negotiated offer" };
 2585 |             if (requestedPrice < trade.negotiation.min_price || requestedPrice > trade.negotiation.max_price) {
 2586 |                 return { success: false, error: `Merchant rejects this price. Allowed range: ${trade.negotiation.min_price}-${trade.negotiation.max_price}.` };
 2587 |             }
 2588 |             if (getGoldAmountInContainer(trade.target_container) < requestedPrice) {
 2589 |                 return { success: false, error: "Merchant cannot cover the negotiated price" };
 2590 |             }
 2591 |             trade.final_price = requestedPrice;
 2592 |             return { success: true, acceptedPrice: requestedPrice };
 2593 |         }
 2594 | 
 2595 |         this._releaseTradeLocks(trade);
 2596 |         trade.offer_items = [];
 2597 |         trade.request_items = [];
 2598 |         const prepResult = this._prepareManualTrade(trade, newOffer, newRequestItems);
 2599 |         return prepResult.success ? { success: true } : prepResult;
 2600 |     }
 2601 | };

 2608 | function getCaravanContents(chestId) {
 2609 |     if (!chestId || !ContainerRegistry.has(chestId)) return "Пусто";
 2610 |     const cont = ContainerRegistry.get(chestId);
 2611 |     if (!cont.items || cont.items.length === 0) return "Пусто";
 2612 |     let contents = [];
 2613 |     cont.items.forEach(itemId => {
 2614 |         const item = ItemRegistry.get(itemId);
 2615 |         if (item) {
 2616 |             let name = item.custom_props?.name || item.prototype_id;
 2617 |             contents.push(`${name} (x${item.stack_size})`);
 2618 |         }
 2619 |     });
 2620 |     return contents.join(", ");
 2621 | }

 2628 |     } else if (objType === 'army') {

 2630 |     }

 2640 |     calculateDistance: function(x1, y1, x2, y2) {

 2643 | 
 2644 |     start: async function(destinationId) {
 2645 |         if (!player) return { success: false, error: "Игрок не найден" };
 2646 |         
 2647 |         let dest = globalLocations[destinationId] || (player.mapMarkers && player.mapMarkers[destinationId]);
 2648 |         const allPoints = [
 2649 |             ...Object.keys(globalLocations || {}).map(k => ({ ...globalLocations[k], id: k })),
 2650 |             ...Object.values(player.mapMarkers || {})
 2651 |         ];
 2652 | 
 2653 |         if (!dest) {
 2654 |             const searchName = String(destinationId).toLowerCase().trim();
 2655 |             
 2656 |             // 1. Поиск по имени
 2657 |             dest = allPoints.find(p => p.name && p.name.toLowerCase().trim().includes(searchName));
 2658 |             
 2659 |             // 2. Поиск по частям ID (устойчивость к перестановке слов, напр. aquilon_capital)
 2660 |             if (!dest) {
 2661 |                 const searchParts = searchName.split(/[_ \-]+/);
 2662 |                 dest = allPoints.find(p => {
 2663 |                     if (!p.id) return false;
 2664 |                     const idLower = p.id.toLowerCase();
 2665 |                     const validParts = searchParts.filter(part => part.length > 2);
 2666 |                     if (validParts.length === 0) return false;
 2667 |                     return validParts.every(part => idLower.includes(part));
 2668 |                 });
 2669 |             }
 2670 |             
 2671 |             // 3. Поиск по частям имени
 2672 |             if (!dest) {
 2673 |                 const searchParts = searchName.split(/[_ \-]+/);
 2674 |                 dest = allPoints.find(p => {
 2675 |                     if (!p.name) return false;
 2676 |                     const nameLower = p.name.toLowerCase();
 2677 |                     const validParts = searchParts.filter(part => part.length > 2);
 2678 |                     if (validParts.length === 0) return false;
 2679 |                     return validParts.some(part => nameLower.includes(part));
 2680 |                 });
 2681 |             }
 2682 |         }
 2683 | 
 2684 |         let startLocId = null;
 2685 |         for (let key in globalLocations) {
 2686 |             if (globalLocations[key].name === player.location) {
 2687 |                 startLocId = key; break;
 2688 |             }
 2689 |         }
 2690 |         if (!startLocId && player.currentSublocation) {
 2691 |             let sub = player.subLocations[player.currentSublocation] || (World && World.subLocations && World.subLocations[player.currentSublocation]);
 2692 |             if (sub && sub.parentId) startLocId = sub.parentId;
 2693 |         }

 2974 | // FIX (Issue #80): parseLocString was vulnerable to:
 2975 | // 1. ReDoS via unescaped itemId/facId in new RegExp()
 2976 | // 2. Stack overflow via recursive parseLocString calls on loc_args
 2977 | // 3. JSON injection via untrusted loc_key/loc_args values
 2978 | // Now: regex special chars are escaped, recursion is depth-limited,
 2979 | // and loc_key values are validated against dangerous patterns.
 2980 | const _locStrRegexCache = new Map();
 2981 | function _escapeRegExp(str) {
 2982 |     return str.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
 2983 | }
 2984 | 
 2985 | function parseLocString(str, disableLoc = window.DISABLE_LOCALIZATION, _depth = 0) {
 2986 |     if (typeof str !== 'string') return str;
 2987 |     let result = str;
 2988 | 
 2989 |     // FIX: Limit recursion depth to prevent stack overflow from nested loc_key strings
 2990 |     const MAX_LOC_RECURSION_DEPTH = 5;
 2991 |     if (_depth >= MAX_LOC_RECURSION_DEPTH) {
 2992 |         console.warn('[i18n] parseLocString recursion depth limit reached, returning raw string');
 2993 |         return str;
 2994 |     }
 2995 | 
 2996 |     if (!disableLoc && str.includes('"loc_key"')) {
 2997 |         const processParsed = (data, originalStr) => {
 2998 |             if (data.loc_args) {
 2999 |                 for (let k in data.loc_args) {
 3000 |                     let argStr = data.loc_args[k];
 3001 |                     if (typeof argStr === 'string') {
 3002 |                         if (typeof ECONOMY_ITEMS !== 'undefined') {
 3003 |                             Object.keys(ECONOMY_ITEMS).forEach(itemId => {
 3004 |                                 // FIX: Escape regex special chars in itemId to prevent ReDoS
 3005 |                                 const cached = _locStrRegexCache.get(itemId);
 3006 |                                 const r = cached || (_locStrRegexCache.set(itemId, new RegExp('\\b' + _escapeRegExp(itemId) + '\\b', 'g')), _locStrRegexCache.get(itemId));
 3007 |                                 if (r.test(argStr)) {
 3008 |                                     argStr = argStr.replace(r, getItemName(itemId, player ? player.era : getRuntimeDefaultEraId()));
 3009 |                                 }
 3010 |                             });
 3011 |                         }
 3012 |                         if (typeof FACILITY_NAMES !== 'undefined') {
 3013 |                             Object.keys(FACILITY_NAMES).forEach(facId => {
 3014 |                                 // FIX: Escape regex special chars in facId to prevent ReDoS
 3015 |                                 const cached = _locStrRegexCache.get('fac:' + facId);
 3016 |                                 const r = cached || (_locStrRegexCache.set('fac:' + facId, new RegExp('\\b' + _escapeRegExp(facId) + '\\b', 'g')), _locStrRegexCache.get('fac:' + facId));
 3017 |                                 if (r.test(argStr)) {
 3018 |                                     argStr = argStr.replace(r, getFacilityName(facId, player ? player.era : getRuntimeDefaultEraId()));
 3019 |                                 }
 3020 |                             });
 3021 |                         }
 3022 |                         if (argStr.includes('"loc_key"')) {
 3023 |                             // FIX: Pass depth counter to limit recursion
 3024 |                             argStr = parseLocString(argStr, disableLoc, _depth + 1);
 3025 |                         }
 3026 |                         data.loc_args[k] = argStr;
 3027 |                     }
 3028 |                 }
 3029 |             }
 3030 |             let trans = t(data.loc_key, data.loc_args, null);
 3031 |             if (trans === null) {
 3032 |                 let fallbackText = data.loc_key.split('.').pop() + ": ";
 3033 |                 if (data.loc_args) fallbackText += Object.values(data.loc_args).join(', ');
 3034 |                 return fallbackText;
 3035 |             }
 3036 |             return trans;
 3037 |         };
 3038 | 
 3039 |         try {
 3040 |             let data = JSON.parse(str);
 3041 |             if (data && data.loc_key) {
 3042 |                 result = processParsed(data, str);
 3043 |             }
 3044 |         } catch(e) {
 3045 |             const regex = /\{"loc_key":"[^"]+"(?:,\s*"loc_args":\{.*?\})?\}/g;
 3046 |             result = str.replace(regex, (match) => {
 3047 |                 try {
 3048 |                     let data = JSON.parse(match);
 3049 |                     if (data && data.loc_key) return processParsed(data, match);
 3050 |                 } catch(err) {
 3051 |                     console.warn('[i18n] Failed to parse location JSON fragment:', match, err.message);
 3052 |                 }
 3053 |                 return match;
 3054 |             });
 3055 |         }
 3056 |     }
 3057 | 
 3058 |     if (window.ModAPI && window.ModAPI.applyTextFilters) {
 3059 |         result = window.ModAPI.applyTextFilters(result);
 3060 |     }
 3061 |     return result;
 3062 | }

 3065 | function getItemName(itemId, eraId) {
 3066 |     const runtimeEraId = getRuntimeDefaultEraId();
 3067 |     if (!eraId) eraId = runtimeEraId;
 3068 |     let locName = t(`economy_items.${itemId}.${eraId}`);
 3069 |     if (locName !== `economy_items.${itemId}.${eraId}`) return locName;
 3070 |     return (ECONOMY_ITEMS[itemId] && ECONOMY_ITEMS[itemId].names)
 3071 |         ? (ECONOMY_ITEMS[itemId].names[eraId] || ECONOMY_ITEMS[itemId].names[runtimeEraId] || ECONOMY_ITEMS[itemId].name || itemId)
 3072 |         : (ECONOMY_ITEMS[itemId]?.name || itemId);
 3073 | }

 3123 | /**
 3124 |  * Auto-save the current game state via the Electron save-game IPC.
 3125 |  * Called on a timer and at key game events (exit, deep setup completion).
 3126 |  */
 3127 | async function autoSaveGame() {
 3128 |     try {
 3129 |         if (!window.electronAPI || typeof window.electronAPI.saveGame !== 'function') {
 3130 |             console.warn('[AutoSave] electronAPI.saveGame not available — skipping.');
 3131 |             return;
 3132 |         }
 3133 |         if (!player || !World) {
 3134 |             console.warn('[AutoSave] No active game to save — skipping.');
 3135 |             return;
 3136 |         }
 3137 | 
 3138 |         const saveData = {
 3139 |             player: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(player)),
 3140 |             world: World,
 3141 |             conversationHistory: conversationHistory || [],
 3142 |             timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
 3143 |             type: 'auto'
 3144 |         };
 3145 | 
 3146 |         const filename = `autosave_${Date.now()}.json`;
 3147 |         const result = await window.electronAPI.saveGame(filename, saveData);
 3148 |         if (result && result.success) {
 3149 |             console.log(`[AutoSave] Saved: ${filename}`);
 3150 |             // Rotate auto-saves: keep only MAX_AUTO_SAVES
 3151 |             if (window.electronAPI.listSaves) {
 3152 |                 const saves = await window.electronAPI.listSaves();
 3153 |                 const autoSaves = (saves || [])
 3154 |                     .filter(s => s.filename && s.filename.startsWith('autosave_'))
 3155 |                     .sort((a, b) => (b.timestamp || '').localeCompare(a.timestamp || ''));
 3156 |                 for (let i = MAX_AUTO_SAVES; i < autoSaves.length; i++) {
 3157 |                     if (window.electronAPI.deleteSave) {
 3158 |                         await window.electronAPI.deleteSave(autoSaves[i].filename);
 3159 |                     }
 3160 |                 }
 3161 |             }
 3162 |         } else {
 3163 |             console.warn('[AutoSave] Save failed:', result);
 3164 |         }
 3165 |     } catch (err) {
 3166 |         console.error('[AutoSave] Error:', err);
 3167 |     }
 3168 | }

 3382 | function processMonsterQuests() {
 3383 |     if (!World || !World.monsters || !player || !player.quests) return;
 3384 | 
 3385 |     let playerRegionId = null;
 3386 |     if (player.location) {
 3387 |         const locLower = player.location.toLowerCase().trim();
 3388 |         for (let rId in World.regions) {
 3389 |             if (locLower.includes(World.regions[rId].name.toLowerCase().trim())) {
 3390 |                 playerRegionId = rId;
 3391 |                 break;
 3392 |             }
 3393 |         }
 3394 |     }
 3395 | 
 3396 |     let questsUpdated = false;
 3397 | 
 3398 |     World.monsters.forEach(m => {
 3399 |         if (m.health > 0 && m.state === "ACTIVE") {
 3400 |             // Выдаем квест ТОЛЬКО если монстр находится в текущем регионе игрока
 3401 |             if (m.region_id === playerRegionId) {
 3402 |                 const questId = "hunt_" + m.id;
 3403 |                 if (!player.quests[questId]) {
 3404 |                     player.quests[questId] = {
 3405 |                         id: questId,
 3406 |                         aiIdentifier: questId,
 3407 |                         title: "Великая Охота: " + m.name,
 3408 |                         objective: "Уничтожить чудовище в регионе " + (World.regions[m.region_id] ? World.regions[m.region_id].name : m.region_id),
 3409 |                         description: "Местные жители в ужасе. Эпическое чудовище терроризирует эти земли. Награда за его голову будет щедрой.",
 3410 |                         reward: "Сокровища логова, Слава",
 3411 |                         issuer: "Местные слухи",
 3412 |                         status: 'active'
 3413 |                     };
 3414 |                     // Блокируем спам в лог во время пре-симуляции и фоновых расчетов

 3447 | function updateWorldSimulation(pulses) {

 3456 |             World.time.accumulatedMinutes -= ticks * 60;

 3938 | // --- XSS PROTECTION: Escape HTML special characters ---
 3939 | function escapeHTML(str) {
 3940 |     if (typeof str !== 'string') return String(str);
 3941 |     return str.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
 3942 |               .replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
 3943 | }
 3944 | // Sanitize HTML content — strip dangerous tags while preserving safe formatting
 3945 | // FIX (Issue #14): The previous regex fallback was bypassable via:
 3946 | // 1. Nested tags: <scr<script>ipt> — after removing inner <script>, outer reassembles
 3947 | // 2. No-space event handlers: <img/onerror=...> — \s+ before on\w+ missed / separator
 3948 | // 3. HTML entity encoding: &#106;avascript: bypasses plain "javascript:" filter
 3949 | // 4. Missing dangerous tags: <body>, <input>, <textarea>, <select>, <details>, <math>
 3950 | // Now: iteratively strip dangerous tags until stable, handle / as attribute separator,
 3951 | // decode HTML entities before checking for javascript: URLs, and cover more tags.
 3952 | function sanitizeHTML(html) {
 3953 |     if (typeof html !== 'string') return '';
 3954 |     // Use DOMPurify if available (loaded in index.html), otherwise fallback to basic sanitization
 3955 |     if (typeof DOMPurify !== 'undefined' && DOMPurify.sanitize) {
 3956 |         return DOMPurify.sanitize(html, { ALLOWED_TAGS: ['b', 'i', 'em', 'strong', 'span', 'br', 'p', 'div', 'ul', 'ol', 'li', 'a'], ALLOWED_ATTR: ['class', 'href', 'style', 'title'] });
 3957 |     }
 3958 |     // Fallback: robust regex sanitization (improved security)
 3959 |     let result = html;
 3960 |     // Iteratively remove dangerous tags until no more changes (handles nested tag bypass)
 3961 |     const DANGEROUS_TAGS = 'script|iframe|object|embed|applet|base|form|meta|link|body|input|textarea|select|button|svg|math|details|summary|template|slot|noscript';
 3962 |     const dangerousTagRegex = new RegExp(`<(${DANGEROUS_TAGS})\\b[^>]*>[\\s\\S]*?<\\/\\1\\s*>`, 'gi');
 3963 |     const dangerousSelfCloseRegex = new RegExp(`<(${DANGEROUS_TAGS})\\b[^>]*\\/?>`, 'gi');
 3964 |     let prev = '';
 3965 |     let iterations = 0;
 3966 |     while (prev !== result && iterations < 10) {
 3967 |         prev = result;
 3968 |         result = result.replace(dangerousTagRegex, '');
 3969 |         result = result.replace(dangerousSelfCloseRegex, '');
 3970 |         iterations++;
 3971 |     }
 3972 |     // Remove on* event handlers — handle both space and / as attribute separators
 3973 |     // Catches: onerror=, onerror =, /onerror=, etc.
 3974 |     result = result.replace(/[\/\s]on\w+\s*=\s*(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^\s>]+)/gi, '');
 3975 |     // Remove javascript: and vbscript: URLs (with optional HTML entities)
 3976 |     // Decode common HTML entities that could bypass the filter
 3977 |     result = result.replace(/(&#(106|74);|&amp;#(106|74);|j\s*&#x0*6[1a];?|j\s*&#x0*4[1a];?|j\s*a\s*v\s*a\s*s\s*c\s*r\s*i\s*p\s*t\s*:)/gi, 'blocked:');
 3978 |     result = result.replace(/(javascript|vbscript|data)\s*:/gi, 'blocked:');
 3979 |     // Remove data: URLs in src attributes

 4420 | 
 4421 | // 3. Создание плашки с результатом (Математика происходит здесь)
 4422 | function createRollBadge(statKey, labelText) {
 4423 |     if (!player) return;
 4424 | 
 4425 |     const container = document.getElementById('active-rolls-container');
 4426 |     if (!container) return;
 4427 | 
 4428 |     if (container.children.length >= 5) return;
 4429 | 
 4430 |     // --- АНТИЧИТ: ЗАПОМИНАНИЕ БРОСКА ---
 4431 |     // Если игрок уже бросал этот кубик в этом ходу, берем старое значение.
 4432 |     // Это не дает "перебрасывать" кубик, удаляя плашку.
 4433 |     let roll;
 4434 |     if (turnRollMemory[statKey]) {
 4435 |         roll = turnRollMemory[statKey];
 4436 |     } else {
 4437 |         roll = rollRuntimeD20();
 4438 |         turnRollMemory[statKey] = roll;
 4439 |     }
 4440 | 
 4441 |     let modifier = 0;
 4442 |     let cleanLabel = labelText.replace(/[\uD800-\uDBFF][\uDC00-\uDFFF]/g, '').trim();
 4443 | 
 4444 |     switch (statKey) {
 4445 |         case 'str':
 4446 |         case 'dex':
 4447 |         case 'int':
 4448 |         case 'con':
 4449 |         case 'cha':
 4450 |             modifier = getStatModifier(statKey);
 4451 |             cleanLabel = `${statKey.toUpperCase()} Check`;
 4452 |             break;
 4453 |         case 'atk':
 4454 |             if (['rogue', 'bard', 'ranger'].includes(player.class)) {
 4455 |                 modifier = getStatModifier('dex');
 4456 |             } else {
 4457 |                 modifier = getStatModifier('str');
 4458 |             }
 4459 |             cleanLabel = "Attack";
 4460 |             break;
 4461 |         case 'def':
 4462 |             modifier = getStatModifier('dex');
 4463 |             cleanLabel = "Defend";
 4464 |             break;
 4465 |         case 'd20':
 4466 |             modifier = 0;
 4467 |             cleanLabel = "D20 Roll";
 4468 |             break;
 4469 |     }
 4470 | 
 4471 |     // Проверяем, нет ли уже такой плашки визуально, чтобы не дублировать
 4472 |     const existingBadges = container.querySelectorAll('.roll-badge');
 4473 |     for (let badge of existingBadges) {

 4511 | // 4. Парсер тегов (превращает {d20_str} в результат броска)
 4512 | function parseInlineRolls(text) {
 4513 |     if (!player) return text;
 4514 | 
 4515 |     // Регулярка ищет всё в фигурных скобках
 4516 |     return text.replace(/\{(.*?)\}/g, (match, content) => {
 4517 |         const tag = content.toLowerCase().trim();
 4518 | 
 4519 |         // Если это команда броска (начинается с d20_) или просто d20
 4520 |         if (tag.startsWith('d20')) {
 4521 |             let roll = rollRuntimeD20();
 4522 |             let modifier = 0;
 4523 |             let label = "D20";
 4524 | 
 4525 |             // Если это специфичный бросок (например d20_str)
 4526 |             if (tag.includes('_')) {
 4527 |                 const statName = tag.split('_')[1];
 4528 | 
 4529 |                 switch (statName) {
 4530 |                     case 'str':
 4531 |                         modifier = Math.floor((player.stats.str - 10) / 2);
 4532 |                         label = "STR Check";
 4533 |                         break;
 4534 |                     case 'dex':
 4535 |                         modifier = Math.floor((player.stats.dex - 10) / 2);
 4536 |                         label = "DEX Check";
 4537 |                         break;
 4538 |                     case 'int':
 4539 |                         modifier = Math.floor((player.stats.int - 10) / 2);
 4540 |                         label = "INT Check";
 4541 |                         break;
 4542 |                     case 'con':
 4543 |                         modifier = Math.floor((player.stats.con - 10) / 2);
 4544 |                         label = "CON Check";
 4545 |                         break;
 4546 |                     case 'cha':
 4547 |                         modifier = Math.floor((player.stats.cha - 10) / 2);
 4548 |                         label = "CHA Check";
 4549 |                         break;
 4550 |                     case 'atk':
 4551 |                         // Авто-выбор стата для атаки
 4552 |                         if (['rogue', 'bard', 'ranger'].includes(player.class)) {
 4553 |                             modifier = Math.floor((player.stats.dex - 10) / 2);
 4554 |                             label = "Attack (DEX)";
 4555 |                         } else {
 4556 |                             modifier = Math.floor((player.stats.str - 10) / 2);
 4557 |                             label = "Attack (STR)";
 4558 |                         }
 4559 |                         break;
 4560 |                     case 'def':
 4561 |                         modifier = Math.floor((player.stats.dex - 10) / 2);
 4562 |                         label = "Defend";
 4563 |                         break;
 4564 |                 }
 4565 |             }
 4566 | 
 4567 |             const total = roll + modifier;
 4568 |             const sign = modifier >= 0 ? "+" : "";
 4569 | 
 4570 |             // Формат вывода: [🎲 STR Check: 15 (roll:12+3)]
 4571 |             return `[рџЋІ ${label}: ${total} (roll:${roll}${sign}${modifier})]`;
 4572 |         }
 4573 | 
 4574 |         // Если тег не распознан, возвращаем как есть
 4575 |         return match;
 4576 |     });
 4577 | }

 4804 | function updateReputationModal() {
 4805 |     if (!player || !reputationModal) return;
 4806 |     const modalTitle = document.querySelector('#reputation-modal h4');
 4807 |     if (modalTitle) modalTitle.textContent = t('gameInterface.reputationModal.title', null, 'Репутация');
 4808 | 
 4809 |     const reputations = player.stats.reputation;
 4810 |     const contentDiv = document.getElementById('reputation-modal-content');
 4811 |     if (!contentDiv) return;
 4812 | 
 4813 |     contentDiv.innerHTML = ''; // Очищаем старое содержимое
 4814 |     let htmlContent = '';
 4815 | 
 4816 |     const factionKeys = Object.keys(reputations).sort((a, b) => {
 4817 |         if (a === 'global') return -1; // global всегда первая
 4818 |         if (b === 'global') return 1;
 4819 |         return a.localeCompare(b);
 4820 |     });
 4821 | 
 4822 |     for (const factionKey of factionKeys) {
 4823 |         const value = reputations[factionKey];
 4824 |         const factionName = player.factionData?.[factionKey] || factionKey;
 4825 | 
 4826 |         const minRep = -100;
 4827 |         const maxRep = 100;
 4828 |         const totalRange = maxRep - minRep;
 4829 |         let markerPositionPercent = ((value - minRep) / totalRange) * 100;
 4830 |         markerPositionPercent = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, markerPositionPercent));
 4831 | 
 4832 |         htmlContent += `
 4833 |             <div class="faction-rep-row">
 4834 |                 <div class="faction-rep-label"><span>${factionName}</span> <span>${value}</span></div>
 4835 |                 <div class="faction-rep-bar-container">
 4836 |                     <div class="reputation-marker-modal" style="left: ${markerPositionPercent}%;"></div>
 4837 |                 </div>
 4838 |             </div>
 4839 |         `;
 4840 |     }
 4841 | 
 4842 |     contentDiv.innerHTML = sanitizeHTML(htmlContent);
 4843 |     reputationModal.classList.add('visible');
 4844 | }

 4846 | function positionReputationModal(event) {
 4847 |     if (!reputationModal || !reputationModal.classList.contains('visible')) return;
 4848 | 
 4849 |     const xOffset = 15;
 4850 |     const yOffset = -10; // Появляется чуть выше курсора
 4851 | 
 4852 |     let newX = event.clientX + xOffset;
 4853 |     let newY = event.clientY + yOffset;
 4854 | 
 4855 |     const modalRect = reputationModal.getBoundingClientRect();
 4856 |     const viewportWidth = window.innerWidth;
 4857 |     const viewportHeight = window.innerHeight;
 4858 | 
 4859 |     // Предотвращаем выход за правый край экрана
 4860 |     if (newX + modalRect.width > viewportWidth - 10) {
 4861 |         newX = event.clientX - modalRect.width - xOffset;
 4862 |     }
 4863 |     // Предотвращаем выход за нижний край, сдвигая вверх
 4864 |     if (newY + modalRect.height > viewportHeight - 10) {
 4865 |         newY = viewportHeight - modalRect.height - 10;
 4866 |     }
 4867 |     // Предотвращаем выход за левый и верхний края
 4868 |     if (newX < 10) newX = 10;
 4869 |     if (newY < 10) newY = 10;
 4870 | 
 4871 |     reputationModal.style.left = `${newX}px`;
 4872 |     reputationModal.style.top = `${newY}px`;
 4873 | }

 4913 |     }
 4914 |     if (calculationLog) {
 4915 |         calculationLog.innerHTML = `<p class="system-message" data-i18n="gameInterface.calcLogPanel.empty">${t('gameInterface.calcLogPanel.empty')}</p>`;
 4916 |         if (player && player.calcLogHistory) {
 4917 |             player.calcLogHistory.forEach(msg => addCalculationMessage(msg, "calc-info", true));
 4918 |         }
 4919 |     }
 4920 |     gameLog.scrollTo({ top: gameLog.scrollHeight, behavior: 'auto' });
 4921 | }

 4924 | 
 4925 | // --- НОВАЯ СИСТЕМА ОБРАБОТКИ СТАТУС-ЭФФЕКТОВ ---
 4926 | 
 4927 | /**
 4928 |  * Главная функция, обрабатывающая все активные статус-эффекты для сущности (игрока).
 4929 |  * Вызывается в начале каждого хода.
 4930 |  * @returns {Array<string>} Массив сообщений для игрового лога.
 4931 |  */
 4932 | function processStatusEffects() {
 4933 |     if (!player || !player.statusEffects) {
 4934 |         return [];
 4935 |     }
 4936 | 
 4937 |     const logMessages = [];
 4938 |     const effectsToRemove = [];
 4939 |     const expiredEffectNames = [];
 4940 | 
 4941 |     for (const effectId in player.statusEffects) {
 4942 |         const effect = player.statusEffects[effectId];
 4943 | 
 4944 |         // --- НОВАЯ ЛОГИКА ПРОВЕРКИ ДЛИТЕЛЬНОСТИ ---
 4945 |         // Сначала проверяем, не истек ли эффект в НАЧАЛЕ этого хода.
 4946 |         if (effect.duration <= 0) {
 4947 |             effectsToRemove.push(effectId);
 4948 |             expiredEffectNames.push(effect.name);
 4949 |             continue; // Переходим к следующему эффекту, не обрабатывая его триггеры в этом ходу
 4950 |         }
 4951 | 
 4952 |         // 1. Обработка триггеров для АКТИВНЫХ эффектов
 4953 |         if (effect.effects && Array.isArray(effect.effects)) {
 4954 |             effect.effects.forEach(subEffect => {
 4955 |                 if (subEffect.trigger && subEffect.action) {
 4956 |                     if (checkEffectTrigger(effect, subEffect.trigger)) {
 4957 |                         const message = applyEffectAction(player, effect, subEffect.action);
 4958 |                         if (message) {
 4959 |                             logMessages.push(message);
 4960 |                         }
 4961 |                     }
 4962 |                 }
 4963 |             });
 4964 |         }
 4965 | 
 4966 |         // 2. Уменьшение длительности В КОНЦЕ обработки хода.
 4967 |         // Теперь эффект с duration: 1 будет действовать этот ход и истечет к началу следующего.
 4968 |         effect.duration--;
 4969 |     }
 4970 | 
 4971 |     // 4. Удаление истекших эффектов и запуск их on_remove действий
 4972 |     if (effectsToRemove.length > 0) {
 4973 |         effectsToRemove.forEach(idToRemove => {
 4974 |             const removedEffect = player.statusEffects[idToRemove];
 4975 |             if (removedEffect) {
 4976 |                 let specificActionOccurred = false;
 4977 | 
 4978 |                 // Запускаем on_remove действия
 4979 |                 if (removedEffect.effects && Array.isArray(removedEffect.effects)) {
 4980 |                     removedEffect.effects.forEach(subEffect => {
 4981 |                         if (subEffect.trigger?.type === 'on_remove') {
 4982 |                             const message = applyEffectAction(player, removedEffect, subEffect.action);
 4983 |                             if (message) {
 4984 |                                 logMessages.push(message);
 4985 |                                 specificActionOccurred = true;
 4986 |                             }
 4987 |                         }
 4988 |                     });
 4989 |                 }
 4990 | 
 4991 |                 // Принудительное восстановление статов
 4992 |                 if (removedEffect.originalValues && typeof removedEffect.originalValues === 'object') {
 4993 |                     for (const statToRestore in removedEffect.originalValues) {
 4994 |                         const restoreAction = { type: 'restore_stat', stat: statToRestore };
 4995 |                         const message = applyEffectAction(player, removedEffect, restoreAction);
 4996 |                         if (message) {
 4997 |                             logMessages.push(message);
 4998 |                             specificActionOccurred = true;
 4999 |                             console.warn(`Принудительное восстановление стата '${statToRestore}' для эффекта '${removedEffect.name}', т.к. GM не предоставил триггер on_remove.`);
 5000 |                         }
 5001 |                     }
 5002 |                 }
 5003 | 
 5004 |                 delete player.statusEffects[idToRemove];
 5005 | 
 5006 |                 if (!specificActionOccurred) {
 5007 |                     logMessages.push(t('gameInterface.commandFeedback.statusEffectRemoved', { effectName: removedEffect.name }));
 5008 |                 }
 5009 |             }
 5010 |         });
 5011 |     }
 5012 | 
 5013 |     // 5. Обновляем UI, если что-то изменилось
 5014 |     if (logMessages.length > 0) {
 5015 |         updateStatusEffectsDisplay();
 5016 |         updateCharacterSheet();
 5017 |     }
 5018 | 
 5019 |     // Возвращаем имена истекших эффектов для передачи GM
 5020 |     player.expiredEffectsForGM = expiredEffectNames;
 5021 |     return logMessages;
 5022 | }
 5023 | 
 5024 | /**
 5025 |  * Проверяет, должен ли сработать триггер эффекта в текущем ходу.
 5026 |  * @param {object} effect - Полный объект статус-эффекта.
 5027 |  * @param {object} trigger - Объект триггера.
 5028 |  * @returns {boolean} - true, если триггер сработал.
 5029 |  */
 5030 | function checkEffectTrigger(effect, trigger) {
 5031 |     if (trigger.type === 'on_turn_start') {
 5032 |         const interval = trigger.interval || 1;
 5033 |         const turnsPassed = player.stats.turnCount - effect.appliedTurn;
 5034 |         // Срабатывает в 0-й ход (сразу при применении) и каждый 'interval' ход после
 5035 |         return turnsPassed >= 0 && turnsPassed % interval === 0;
 5036 |     }
 5037 |     // Здесь можно добавить другие типы триггеров: on_damage_taken, on_attack, и т.д.
 5038 |     return false;
 5039 | }
 5040 | 
 5041 | /**
 5042 |  * Применяет конкретное действие эффекта к сущности.
 5043 |  * @param {object} entity - Сущность, на которую действует эффект (пока только player).
 5044 |  * @param {object} effect - Родительский статус-эффект (для хранения originalValues).
 5045 |  * @param {object} action - Объект действия.
 5046 |  * @returns {string|null} Сообщение для лога или null.
 5047 |  */
 5048 | function applyEffectAction(entity, effect, action) {
 5049 |     let message = null;
 5050 |     try {
 5051 |         switch (action.type) {
 5052 |             case 'modify_stat': {
 5053 |                 const { stat, change } = action;
 5054 |                 const changeValue = parseInt(change, 10);
 5055 |                 if (!entity.stats || isNaN(changeValue)) break;
 5056 | 
 5057 |                 const oldValue = entity.stats[stat] || 0;
 5058 |                 entity.stats[stat] = oldValue + changeValue;
 5059 | 
 5060 |                 // Ограничения
 5061 |                 if (stat === 'hp') {
 5062 |                     entity.stats.hp = Math.max(0, Math.min(entity.stats.hp, entity.stats.maxHp));
 5063 |                 }
 5064 |                 if (stat === 'mana' && entity.class === 'mage') {
 5065 |                     entity.stats.mana = Math.max(0, Math.min(entity.stats.mana, entity.stats.maxMana));
 5066 |                 }
 5067 | 
 5068 |                 const statName = t(`gameInterface.characterPanel.${stat}`, null, stat);
 5069 |                 const changeText = changeValue > 0 ? `+${changeValue}` : changeValue;
 5070 |                 message = t('gameInterface.log.effectModifyStat', { effectName: effect.name, statName: statName, change: changeText });
 5071 |                 break;
 5072 |             }
 5073 |             case 'set_stat': {
 5074 |                 const { stat, value } = action;
 5075 |                 const setValue = parseInt(value, 10);
 5076 |                 if (!entity.stats || isNaN(setValue)) break;
 5077 | 
 5078 |                 // Сохраняем оригинальное значение, если оно еще не сохранено
 5079 |                 if (!effect.originalValues) {
 5080 |                     effect.originalValues = {};
 5081 |                 }
 5082 |                 if (effect.originalValues[stat] === undefined) {
 5083 |                     effect.originalValues[stat] = entity.stats[stat] || 0;
 5084 |                 }
 5085 | 
 5086 |                 entity.stats[stat] = setValue;
 5087 |                 const statName = t(`gameInterface.characterPanel.${stat}`, null, stat);
 5088 |                 message = t('gameInterface.log.effectSetStat', { effectName: effect.name, statName: statName, value: setValue });
 5089 |                 break;
 5090 |             }
 5091 |             case 'restore_stat': {
 5092 |                 const { stat } = action;
 5093 |                 if (effect.originalValues && effect.originalValues[stat] !== undefined) {
 5094 |                     entity.stats[stat] = effect.originalValues[stat];
 5095 |                     const statName = t(`gameInterface.characterPanel.${stat}`, null, stat);
 5096 |                     message = t('gameInterface.log.effectRestoreStat', { effectName: effect.name, statName: statName, value: entity.stats[stat] });
 5097 |                     delete effect.originalValues[stat]; // Очищаем сохраненное значение
 5098 |                 }
 5099 |                 break;
 5100 |             }
 5101 |         }
 5102 |     } catch (e) {
 5103 |         console.error("Ошибка применения действия эффекта:", e, action);
 5104 |     }
 5105 |     return message;
 5106 | }

 5130 | function setActiveScreen(screenId) {
 5131 |     const overlays = [
 5132 |         document.getElementById('custom-alert-modal'),
 5133 |         document.getElementById('save-slot-modal'),
 5134 |         document.getElementById('custom-confirm-modal'),
 5135 |         document.getElementById('menu-overlay'),
 5136 |         document.getElementById('loading-overlay'),
 5137 |         document.getElementById('ai-error-modal')
 5138 |     ];
 5139 |     overlays.forEach(el => { if (el) { el.classList.remove('visible'); el.style.display = 'none'; } });
 5140 | 
 5141 |     const allScreens = [mainMenu, settingsMenu, characterCreationScreen, loadGameScreen, helpScreen, narratorSelectionScreen, worldSetupScreen, gameInterface, document.getElementById('mods-menu')];
 5142 |     const currentActive = document.querySelector('.menu-screen.active-screen, .main-menu-screen.active-screen, .game-container.active-screen');
 5143 |     const targetScreen = document.getElementById(screenId);
 5144 | 
 5145 |     const executeSwap = () => {
 5146 |         allScreens.forEach(screen => {
 5147 |             if (screen) {
 5148 |                 screen.classList.remove('active-screen');
 5149 |                 if (screen.id !== screenId) screen.style.display = 'none';
 5150 |             }
 5151 |         });
 5152 |         if (targetScreen) {
 5153 |             targetScreen.style.display = 'flex';
 5154 |             requestAnimationFrame(() => {
 5155 |                 targetScreen.classList.add('active-screen');
 5156 |                 if (screenId === 'character-creation-screen') {
 5157 |                     const nameInput = document.getElementById('char-name-input');
 5158 |                     if (nameInput) nameInput.focus();
 5159 |                 }
 5160 |             });
 5161 |         }
 5162 |     };
 5163 | 
 5164 |     // Анимация ухода из главного меню
 5165 |     if (currentActive && currentActive.id === 'main-menu' && screenId !== 'main-menu') {
 5166 |         const leftBlock = currentActive.querySelector('.mm-left-block');
 5167 |         if (leftBlock) leftBlock.style.animation = 'slideOutLeft 0.3s forwards cubic-bezier(0.7, 0, 0.3, 1)';
 5168 |         setTimeout(executeSwap, 250);
 5169 |     } 
 5170 |     // Анимация возврата в главное меню
 5171 |     else if (screenId === 'main-menu') {
 5172 |         if (currentActive) currentActive.classList.remove('active-screen'); // Начинаем фейд-аут текущего
 5173 |         setTimeout(() => {
 5174 |             executeSwap();
 5175 |             const leftBlock = targetScreen.querySelector('.mm-left-block');
 5176 |             if (leftBlock) leftBlock.style.animation = 'slideInLeft 0.4s forwards cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)';
 5177 |         }, 200);
 5178 |     } 
 5179 |     // Обычный переход
 5180 |     else {
 5181 |         executeSwap();
 5182 |     }
 5183 | }

 5469 | function updateApiKeyStatus() {
 5470 |     let statusKey;
 5471 |     let statusClass;
 5472 |     let keyIsMissing = false;
 5473 | 
 5474 |     if (currentApiProvider === 'local' || currentApiProvider === 'dummy') {

 5478 |         statusKey = 'mainMenu.apiKeyStatusFound';
 5479 |         statusClass = 'status-ok';
 5480 |     } else {
 5481 |         let keyToCheck = geminiApiKey;
 5482 |         switch (currentApiProvider) {
 5483 |             case 'gemini':
 5484 |                 keyToCheck = geminiApiKeys[currentGeminiKeyIndex] || geminiApiKey;
 5485 |                 break;

 5488 |                 break;
 5489 |             case 'openrouter':
 5490 |                 keyToCheck = openrouterApiKey;
 5491 |                 break;
 5492 |             case 'deepseek':
 5493 |                 keyToCheck = deepseekApiKey;
 5494 |                 break;
 5495 |             case 'omniroute':
 5496 |                 keyToCheck = omnirouteApiKey;
 5497 |                 break;
 5498 |         }
 5499 | 
 5500 |         if (keyToCheck && keyToCheck.trim() !== '') {
 5501 |             statusKey = 'mainMenu.apiKeyStatusFound';
 5502 |             statusClass = 'status-ok';
 5503 |         } else {
 5504 |             statusKey = 'mainMenu.apiKeyStatusMissing';
 5505 |             statusClass = 'status-error';
 5506 |             keyIsMissing = true;
 5507 |         }
 5508 |     }
 5509 |

 5511 |         apiKeyStatus.textContent = t(statusKey, {

 5515 |     }

 5518 |         newGameButton.disabled = keyIsMissing;

 5520 |     }

 5568 | function playMusic(index) {
 5569 |     if (!audioPlayer || musicFiles.length === 0 || index < 0 || index >= musicFiles.length) {
 5570 |         console.warn("Не удается воспроизвести музыку: нет плеера, нет файлов или неверный индекс.", index);
 5571 |         return;
 5572 |     }
 5573 |     if (!userInteractedForMusic && currentTrackIndex !== -1) {
 5574 |         console.log("Музыка заблокирована до первого взаимодействия пользователя с кнопкой переключения.");
 5575 |         return;
 5576 |     }
 5577 | 
 5578 |     const trackSrc = SOUND_FOLDER_PATH + musicFiles[index];
 5579 |     if (audioPlayer.currentSrc.endsWith(trackSrc) && !audioPlayer.paused) {
 5580 |         console.log(`Трек ${musicFiles[index]} уже играет.`);
 5581 |         return;
 5582 |     }
 5583 | 
 5584 |     console.log(`Попытка воспроизвести музыку: ${musicFiles[index]}`);
 5585 |     audioPlayer.src = trackSrc;
 5586 |     audioPlayer.volume = musicVolume;
 5587 |     audioPlayer.loop = true; // Зацикливаем трек
 5588 | 
 5589 |     const playPromise = audioPlayer.play();
 5590 | 
 5591 |     if (playPromise !== undefined) {
 5592 |         playPromise.then(_ => {
 5593 |             console.log(`Играет: ${musicFiles[index]}`);
 5594 |             isMusicPlaying = true;
 5595 |             currentTrackIndex = index;
 5596 |             updateMusicToggleButton(true);
 5597 |         }).catch(error => {
 5598 |             console.warn(`Воспроизведение музыки не удалось для ${musicFiles[index]}:`, error);
 5599 |             isMusicPlaying = false;
 5600 |             updateMusicToggleButton(false);
 5601 |         });
 5602 |     } else {
 5603 |         isMusicPlaying = !audioPlayer.paused;
 5604 |         currentTrackIndex = index;
 5605 |         updateMusicToggleButton(isMusicPlaying);
 5606 |     }
 5607 | }
 5608 | 
 5609 | function pauseMusic() {
 5610 |     if (!audioPlayer || audioPlayer.paused) return;
 5611 |     audioPlayer.pause();
 5612 |     isMusicPlaying = false;
 5613 |     updateMusicToggleButton(false);
 5614 |     console.log("Музыка на паузе.");
 5615 | }

 5617 | function toggleMusic() {
 5618 |     if (!toggleMusicButton) return;
 5619 | 
 5620 |     if (!userInteractedForMusic) {
 5621 |         userInteractedForMusic = true;
 5622 |         console.log("Обнаружено взаимодействие пользователя, включение воспроизведения музыки.");
 5623 |         if (!isMusicPlaying) {
 5624 |             const indexToPlay = currentTrackIndex >= 0 ? currentTrackIndex : 0;
 5625 |             playMusic(indexToPlay);
 5626 |         }
 5627 |         return;
 5628 |     }
 5629 |

 5631 |         pauseMusic();

 5633 |         if (audioPlayer.readyState >= 2 && audioPlayer.currentSrc) {
 5634 |             const playPromise = audioPlayer.play();
 5635 |             if (playPromise !== undefined) {
 5636 |                 playPromise.then(() => {
 5637 |                     isMusicPlaying = true;
 5638 |                     updateMusicToggleButton(true);
 5639 |                 }).catch(e => console.error("Ошибка возобновления музыки:", e));
 5640 |             } else {
 5641 |                 isMusicPlaying = true;
 5642 |                 updateMusicToggleButton(true);
 5643 |             }
 5644 |         } else {
 5645 |             playMusic(0);
 5646 |         }
 5647 |     }
